jobs.title: PROGRAM COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**The Opportunity**

Come join our team! Homeward Bound helps unsheltered individuals and families in Marin County transform their lives through housing, training, and supportive services.

Homeward Bound is Marin County’s primary provider of shelter and housing for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. We offer emergency shelter, short- and long-term supportive housing, job training and placement, and wraparound services. Our mission is **Opening Doors to Safety, Dignity, Hope, and Independence**.

We are seeking a **Program Coordinator** to join our adult shelter and housing team.

**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide housing-focused case management in one-on-one settings for up to 24 single adults across the housing team’s portfolio.
* Facilitate client groups and events across the team’s housing portfolio.
* Incorporate **intensive care coordination and housing stabilization strategies** into individualized housing and care plans, in collaboration with healthcare, behavioral health, and community-based partners.
* Identify and address barriers to housing stabilization, including chronic homelessness, mental and physical health needs, substance use disorders, under-employment, lack of income, and other systemic barriers.
* Skillfully prevent and/or resolve conflicts skillfully using a strengths-based approach.
* Respond to urgent and crisis situations, including coordination with EMTs, fire, law enforcement, psychiatric services, and community partners as needed.
* Prevent and resolve conflicts using a strengths-based, trauma-informed approach.
* Provide supportive services, guidance, and referrals to community resources.
* Engage program participants regularly and consistently to support program participation and progress toward housing stability.

**Documentation and Compliance**

* Complete timely, accurate, and compliant documentation, including billable case notes, assessments, care plans, and progress updates, in accordance with policies and funder requirements.
* Ensure client records clearly demonstrate eligibility, service delivery, engagement, and progress toward housing, health, and personal goals.
* Maintain accurate and timely data entry in HIPPO (Salesforce database) and HMIS.
* Meet all documentation and case management deadlines, including intake, enrollment, reassessments, housing goals, and discharge documentation.
* Participate in quality assurance, monitoring, and audit processes, including responding to documentation reviews and corrective actions.

**Case Management, Housing-Focused Services, and Outcomes**

* Develop, implement, and regularly update individualized, client-centered housing and care plans.
* Monitor, document, and adjust plans proactively to address changing needs or barriers.
* Coordinate services with internal teams and external partners to ensure continuity of care and timely referrals.
* Document housing and service outcomes to support program performance measurement and funder reporting.
* Develop, implement, and monitor financial literacy services tailored to covering topics such as budgeting, credit repair, savings strategies, and employment preparedness.
* Assist program participants in housing retention, job readiness skills, job placement and retention services, education on living skills, navigating resources and referrals, eviction diversion, and addressing physical and mental health issues.

**Property Management and Housing Placement**

* Assist the Senior Director of Housing and Program Manager with client identification and screening for housing eligibility, leasing, and client move-ins
* Assist the Senior Director with refining program policies and practices, unit setup and purchasing, and facility troubleshooting
* Promptly submit documentation to the Marin Housing Authority for the issuance of client vouchers and rental calculations/recalculations as needed
* Assist with property management, including but not limited to creating and tracking maintenance requests, maintaining site presence across the housing campus, tracking client rental payments, issuing legal notices, and documenting tenancy challenges
* Proactively monitor building needs, perform rounds, coordinate closely with facilities

**Professional Standards and Team Collaboration**

* Manage a full caseload and bi-weekly/monthly meetings, with strong organization, time-management, and prioritization skills.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with supervisors, team members, volunteers, agency partners, and program participants.
* Participate in weekly supervision, program meetings, all-staff meetings, and required training.
* Maintain confidentiality and comply with all agency policies, including HIPAA where applicable.
* Contribute positively as a collaborative, accountable member of the Homeward Bound team.
* Strong organizational skills

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education / Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in social work, psychology, social welfare, or a related field **OR** three (3) years of experience in a related residential or housing program.

**Experience & Knowledge**

* Minimum of three (3) years’ experience working with under-resourced or low-income populations; experience working with individuals experiencing homelessness preferred.
* Experience in residential and/or housing programs.
* Knowledge of Housing First and harm-reduction principles.
* Working knowledge of SSI, SSDI, and SDI.
* Working knowledge of local resources for low-income individuals.
* Experience with data entry systems (HMIS, Salesforce, or similar).
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, cloud-based systems, and Adobe.
* Comfort working in a culturally and ethnically diverse environment.
* Working knowledge of substance dependence disorders and mental health disorders.
* Ability to read and interpret documents, write routine reports and correspondence, and speak effectively before small groups of clients or employees of the organization.

jobs.title: Advanced Practice Provider (APP) Residency Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

Marin Community Clinics, founded in 1972, is today, a multi-clinic network with a wide array of integrated primary care, dental, behavioral, specialty and referral services. As a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC), we provide vital health services to almost 40,000 individuals annually in Marin County. The Clinics regularly receive national awards from the Health Resources and Services Administrations (HRSA). Our Mission is to promote health and wellness through excellent, compassionate care for all.

The APP Residency Program Coordinator manages the daily operational, administrative, and tracking components of Marin Community Clinic’s postgraduate Nurse Practitioner (NP) and Physician Assistant (PA) residency program. This position serves as the primary administrative point of contact for residents, clinical faculty, and leadership. A key focus of this role during the first year will be establishing robust tracking systems and documentation standards to prepare the program for official national accreditation applications.

**Work Schedule:**

Please note that the Coordinator responsibilities represent 0.70 FTE of this position. Internal candidate selected for the role will be expected to continue performing the remaining 0.30 FTE of their current clinical or departmental duties, subject to departmental needs and manager approval.

  
Responsibilities:

**Program Administration & Operations**

* Manage day-to-day administrative tasks for the NP/PA residency program, including onboarding logistics, orientation schedules, and day-to-day schedules.
* Coordinate complex clinical scheduling, including primary care continuity clinics, specialty rotations, and dedicated didactic/educational sessions.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for residency applicants, coordinating the recruitment, interview, and selection processes.

**Accreditation Preparation & Data Tracking**

* Build and maintain highly accurate program records, including attendance, clinical hour logs, and faculty/resident evaluation data.
* Monitor tracking systems to ensure residents are meeting mandatory case volumes, procedural competencies, and educational milestones.
* Organize, centralize, and archive all program policies, curriculum materials, and administrative files to build the foundational documentation required for the accreditation application at the 1-year mark.

**Communication & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Act as the core administrative liaison between residents, preceptors, site directors, and external specialty rotation partners to ensure clear communication.
* Organize and document meetings.
* Provide high-level administrative support to the Residency Program Director for curriculum updates and strategic program development.

Qualifications:

**Education and Experience:**

* High School Diploma or Equivalent (GED) required.
* 1 to 2 years of experience working in a healthcare setting or a healthcare administrative role.
* Experience specifically within Advanced Practice Provider (APP) or medical residency programs is highly desirable.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Teams) and EPIC. Ability to quickly learn and navigate residency management or scheduling software.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent organizational skills with a strong attention to detail (essential for building future accreditation-ready records).
* Outstanding interpersonal and communication skills, with a collaborative approach to supporting adult learners in a community clinic environment.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality regarding sensitive resident and personnel information.
* A deep commitment to community health and serving diverse, medically underserved populations.
* Candidate must be comfortable working at both the Novato and San Rafael clinic locations and commuting between sites as needed.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Fulfill immunization and fit for duty regulatory requirements.
* Ability to travel between clinic sites within Marin County and work flexible hours as required.
* Prolonged standing and walking
* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer, with keyboard and mouse.
* Must be able to lift to 15 pounds at times.
* Ability to work in fast pace medical environments.

**Benefits:**  
Our benefits program is designed to protect your health, family and way of life. We offer a competitive Benefits Program that includes affordable health insurance and Health Reimbursement Accounts (HRA), Dental and Vision Insurance, Educational and Continuing Education Benefits, Student Loan Repayment and Loan Forgiveness, Retirement Plan, Group Life and AD&D Insurance, Short term and Long Term Disability benefits, Professional Fee Reimbursement, Mileage and Cell Phone Reimbursement, Scrubs Reimbursement, Loupes Reimbursement, Employee Assistance Programs, Paid Holidays, Personal Days of Celebration, Paid time off, and Extended Illness Benefits.

*Marin Community Clinics is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer*

Min: USD $26.00/Hr. Max: USD $32.00/Hr.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator (4167U), Institute of European Studies - #89592
jobs.description:
Program Coordinator (4167U), Institute of European Studies - #89592 About Berkeley
  
  
At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  
At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  
We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  
Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  
Departmental Overview
  
  
The Institute of European Studies (IES) at UC Berkeley is the leading research center on Europe in the Western United States, and among the top three such organizations in the nation. Through interdisciplinary scholarship, international collaborations, grant opportunities and community outreach, IES fosters a deeper understanding of Europe's past, present, and future.
  
  
**IES Mission:** Support innovative research and teaching on contemporary and historical Europe, the European Union, and transatlantic relations. Promote academic and cultural ties with European partners. Provide a community for students and faculty who share a European focus to their work. Foster dialogue between scholars, practitioners, policymakers, and the public.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
The Program Coordinator supports the organized research activities and programming agendas of the France Berkeley Fund (FBF) and the Institute of European Studies (IES) in consultation with the directors of both organizations. This position supports outreach, communications, program development, and fundraising. To further the mission of both programs, the Program Coordinator promotes and supports research by UCB faculty and visiting researchers via the France Berkeley Fund and the IES Global Exchange programs.
  
  
Responsibilities
  
  
Plans and develops new programs and adjusts existing programs in a research and public education environment.
  
Actively participates with faculty directors (FBF and IES) in long-range strategic planning for research and public educational programs. The FBF, Austrian Studies, Ctr. of French Excellence, Visiting Scholar, and URAP programs.
  
Monitors and coordinates activities according to the terms of the funding agreements.
  
Participates in developing constituencies and promoting programs to target audiences.
  
Identifies and develops evaluation tools for programs.
  
Under general supervision, assists in implementing specific activities for specific fundraising programs and activities.
  
  
Required Qualifications
  
  
Working skills to produce and deliver programs.
  
Good reading, verbal, written and interpersonal communication skills, and good presentation skills.
  
Reading knowledge of basic French.
  
Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience / training
  
Continuing education in related field required.
  
  
Preferred Qualifications
  
  
Working knowledge of departmental and organization policies and procedures and/or the ability to learn; knowledge of educational program content and objectives.
  
Working knowledge of delivering public educational programs.
  
Working knowledge of current public education programs and trends.
  
Working knowledge of conducting needs assessment.
  
Good analytical skills to understand how business needs can be addressed through the design and delivery of training programs.
  
Additional European Languages a plus.
  
  
Salary & Benefits
  
  
For information on the comprehensive benefits package offered by the University, please visit the University of California's Compensation & Benefits website.
  
  
Under California law, the University of California, Berkeley is required to provide a reasonable estimate of the compensation range for this role and should not offer a salary outside of the range posted in this job announcement. This range takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including but not limited to experience, skills, knowledge, abilities, education, licensure and certifications, analysis of internal equity, and other business and organizational needs. It is not typical for an individual to be offered a salary at or near the top of the range for a position. Salary offers are determined based on final candidate qualifications and experience.
  
  
The budgeted hourly range that the University reasonably expects to pay for this position is $30.17 - $38.31.
  
  
This is a non-exempt, bi-weekly paid position.
  
This is a 4-month, full-time, Limited [temporary] position that is eligible for UC benefits.

jobs.title: Medical Student Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

Reporting to the Associate Administrative Director, MedEd, the Medical Student Clerkship Coordinator position will provide overall high-level support to Medical Student Education Program primarily by coordinating the Traditional Clerkship, including Clinical Skills Sessions and Didactics series for the traditional clerkship, support of the PISCES Longitudinal Clerkship Clinical Skills Session and site scheduling plus PISCES School didactics. Specific duties include primary interface with all clerkship sites, site administration of the Mission Bay/Mt. Zion clerkship site, proctoring exams 7 times a year; preparing student orientation materials and presentations; assistance with coordinating education program research and student research opportunities alongside the Medical Education Director; primary initiator of clerkship student assessment and grading needs, plus general course coordination. This position also is the point person in coordinating the Volunteer Clinical Professor (VCP) program. The major functions are communicating as the department representative with the volunteer professor and HR representative, managing the volunteer clinical faculty (VCP) database, and producing annual evaluation reports for academic and non-VCP instructors. This position will also interface with ENACT (UCSF-Stanford Endometriosis Center for Discovery, Innovation, Training and Community Engagement) on specifics related to Endometriosis research. This role also serves as backup for the F1 and Undergraduate Research Internship (URI) Administrator on various tasks and provides support to the Associate Administrative Director and Faculty Program Directors. There may be other duties as needed.

**DEPARTMENT INFO:**

The Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology and Reproductive Sciences (Ob, Gyn & RS) is a major academic Department in the School of Medicine, engaged in clinical, research and training activities at the Parnassus, Mt. Zion and San Francisco General Hospital campuses, the Betty Irene Moore Women’s Hospital at Mission Bay, as well as satellite locations throughout the Bay Area, with an annual operating budget of $146 million. The Department has 111 full-time faculty, 117 other academic appointees, 13 post-doctoral fellows, 20 clinical fellows, 32 residents, 138 voluntary clinical faculty and 270 staff. The mission of the UCSF Department of Ob, Gyn & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in Patient Care, Scientific Discovery, Education, Advocacy, Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. “Leading the way in women’s health.”

The mission of the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology & Reproductive Sciences is to improve the lives and health of all women through excellence, innovation and leadership in patient care, scientific discovery, education, advocacy, and diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to providing quality health care services; educating health care providers and investigators; and conducting research to advance knowledge in our field.

Reasonable accommodation(s) to qualified individuals with disabilities are available as part of the application and interview processes. jobs.title: Temporary Case Manager, Stability
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**

At Hamilton Families, our mission is to end family homelessness in the San Francisco Bay Area. Since 1985, we have been meeting the most urgent needs of unhoused families in our community. Our programs specialize in preventing family homelessness when possible, providing shelter and transitional housing to families in times of need, supporting the wellbeing and academic achievement of children who experience homelessness, and quickly returning families to safe and stable housing throughout the Greater Bay Area. At Hamilton Families, we believe the San Francisco Bay Area is at its best when people from all backgrounds can start a life here, raise a family here, and thrive here. We envision a Bay Area where housing is accessible and affordable, where homelessness is rare, brief, and nonrecurring, and where all people and families have a safe and stable place to live. We foster an inclusive environment where diverse perspectives are valued and contribute to our collective success. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures every team member feels respected, supported, and empowered to thrive.

**What You’ll Do**

We’re excited to be adding a **Case Manager, Stability,** toour growing team! This is an engaging and rewarding opportunity that plays an integral role within the organization. We are looking for someone who is passionate about working with our participants and contributing to the fight against homelessness. This position requires the individual to be bilingual in Spanish in order to better serve our community. The **Case Manager, Stability**, will report directly to the Shelter Coordinator and be part of the Housing Solutions team. This position provides case management to families in the rental subsidy program using various service models. This involves documenting services in real-time, maintaining electronic case records, and collecting monthly compliance reports.

**What Your Day Looks Like**

* Provide home-based support to around 20 families, including goal setting, housing advocacy, and connecting them to resources for budgeting, employment, legal support, and more
* Assess participants’ needs and challenges, such as employment status or mental health, and connect them to appropriate resources
* Assist families in setting and reaching housing goals, manage necessary documentation, and address related concerns
* Check in with participants who have completed the program to ensure continued progress
* Foster self-sufficiency and maintain professional boundaries using various service models
* Collaborate with internal teams, and external partners to address housing issues and support participants
* Maintain accurate records and adhere to confidentiality documentation standards
* Address resource needs in specific areas and help organize community events such as Holiday celebrations and Back-to-School activities
* Partner on departmental projects as needed
* Advocate for our services and represent Hamilton Families at community and collaborative meetings

**What Makes You Successful in This Role**

* Ability to work and collaborate with a diverse group of people on projects and making decisions for the benefit of our participants
* Familiarity with case management databases or customer service platforms
* Highly organized, self-motivated, and capable of working independently to meet goals
* Demonstrated ability to exercise appropriate judgement and uphold policies and procedures
* Skilled in documentation, reporting, and maintaining confidentiality

**What You Bring**

* 1+ years of experience in social work, psychology, human services setting or related field
* A background in working with nonprofit organizations, social services organizations, or community-based programs
* Familiarity with Bay Area resources for low-income families
* Bilingual abilities, especially in Spanish
* Highly proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, Salesforce, and other software
* Ability to travel locally and long distance to meet with vendors and participants

**Why Choose Us**

* Our commitment to welcome all individuals creates a richness of viewpoints and keen ability to challenge established thinking
* Enjoy excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
* Employer matched 403(b) retirement plan
* Wellness and commuter benefit programs
* Paid time off and holidays

**Our Values**

* Resourceful
* Helpful/ “Yes, And”
* Growth Mindset
* Data Informed
* EDI: Equitable, Diverse, and Inclusive

**Position Type:** Full-time, Non-Exempt

**Union Representation:** Yes

**Schedule:** Monday –Friday, 9:00am – 5:30pm

**Location:** 2567 Mission Street, San Francisco, CA 94110 + Fieldwork

jobs.title: Case Manager
jobs.description:
**Lao Family Community Development, Inc. (LFCD)** is a community development non-profit agency established in the City of Richmond in Contra Costa County in 1980. Today Lao Family has expanded its operations and service footprint to two additional counties, including Alameda and Sacramento. LFCD’s headquarters office is in Oakland, CA. It delivers programs and services from 7 locations in 35 languages. The agency provides both community development real estate facilities and a diverse array of workforce, education, and human services that directly support predominantly low-income US-born high-barrier families and individuals, refugees, immigrants, transitional age youth, seniors, and other special populations such as individuals with disabilities.

**Job Summary:** TheYouth Employment Programs builds career awareness and provides employment support for youth aged 16-30. Through career exploration, work readiness training, and employment, the program will provide youth with internship experience, skill-building supports, and exposure to career options and pathways. Programs funded The State of California, The City of Oakland, as well as managing participants under the California Advancing and Innovating Medical (Cal-AIM) Initiative, which provides comprehensive care management to address both clinical and non-clinical needs. The case manager provides job readiness workshops, career counseling, outreach-recruitment for participants & employers, provides ongoing support to these individuals, performs leadership development activities, follow-up and retention services. The position requires outreach work, workshop facilitation, educational resources, work site development, life skills, and case management. This position reports to the Program Coordinator.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Plan and conduct major community outreach, attend resource fairs to recruit low-income Oakland residents, out-of-school youth from 16 -30 of age, who are not working and not in school.
* Contact youth, explain about youth employment programs, and invite them for orientation.
* Provide intensive direct services to youth, including: intake assessment, certify and obtain supportive documents for enrollment into the program, orientation for youth and family members, and information referral.
* Develop Individual Service Strategy (ISS) Plan, Objective Assessment to identify career goal and make appropriate referrals for post-secondary education/vocational training
* Conduct job readiness workshops and assist in the development of curriculum for new modules that integrate best practices in the employment and youth development fields.
* Provide one-on-one counseling and assist youth with worksite placements
* Cultivate, build trust, and maintain business relationships with employers and other community service providers.
* Target prospective employers with job openings at reasonable starting wages with fringe benefits for youth participants.
* Community Support: Services to address members’ health-related social needs to improve health and well-being.
* Assist in organizing the annual youth leadership empowering conference.
* Identify career exploration, labor market information, career panels with guest speakers, field trip, career fair, job referrals, and respond to workforce needs.
* Data input, keep track of all activities including CalJOBS, CitySpan, Apricot, Care Management System (CMS).
* In-house tracking system, daily log, case notes, and all other activities follow program policy and procedure.
* Conduct worksite visit, follow-up subsidized/unsubsidized job placements, job retention, and supportive services.
* Represent LFCD at local collaborative community meetings, attend all the required trainings, employment-related meetings, or conferences as assigned.

jobs.description:
**At Rocketship Public Schools, we believe in the infinite possibility of human potential.** We believe that every student deserves the right to dream, to discover, and to develop their unique potential and it is our responsibility and our privilege to unleash the potential inside every Rocketeer we serve. Our non-profit network of public elementary charter schools propels student achievement, develops exceptional educators, and partners with parents who enable high-quality public schools to thrive in their community. We are a collective of parents, teachers, leaders, and students working together to transform the future for underserved communities across our country. At Rocketship Public Schools, we are unleashing potential.

Rocketship school leadership teams each include a Principal and Assistant Principals focused on instruction, an Office Manager focused on student information and family engagement, and a school leader focused on all other operations aspects of running the school - what some might call an “AP of Operations,” though we at Rocketship call it a Business Operations Manager (BOM). The BOM reports directly to the Principal and manages a team of hourly Operations Specialists. As the Operations leader, the BOM is responsible for all aspects of student meals, recess, arrival, dismissal, physical space, and safety at their campus. Thus, the role requires not only the ability to manage “business” topics like logistics and compliance, but also a deep understanding of behavior management, culture-setting, and behavior management coaching. The BOM helps ensure the school has a consistent culture across spaces, keeps our students safe, and ultimately enables instructional staff to focus on teaching and learning. This means BOMs are multi-talented leaders who can build systems, own processes like procurement and facilities maintenance, and partner with all adults on campus to support our students. The BOM role is an excellent opportunity for operationally-minded teachers and school leaders who want to grow and develop through an operational school leadership position.

### **Essential Functions**

* The essential functions of this position include, but are not limited to the following:

**Schoolwide Systems & Culture**

* Own the logistics, staffing, and daily management of arrival, lunch, recess, dismissal and physical space at your campus; ensuring joy and safety exude in all systems!
* Coach Operations Specialists daily in behavior management techniques, through both “in-the-moment coaching” and planned 1:1s.
* Design and lead professional development for Operations Specialists focused on behavior management skill development.
* Manage the physical space of the building and all facilities-related needs, including scheduling/meeting vendors and handling after-hours facilities emergencies.

**Compliance & Budget**

* Ensure your campus is financially responsible by providing support to the Principal on finance-related topics, including around budgets, cash collection, and invoice approval.
* Serve as the main owner of school safety processes and compliance, including administering training and running safety drills. Partner with the Principal to respond to emergencies.
* Own procurement and purchasing for the school site. Work with Principal to understand needs, place orders, inventory items received, handle returns/exchanges, etc.
* Serve as on-site IT contact, including managing IT assets, assisting staff with IT issues as able, and serving as the main touchpoint to central IT staff.
* Support the logistical, compliance, and technology side of administration of Rocketship’s assessments, including NWEA MAP and state tests, and health screenings like hearing and vision.
* CA Only: Own free/reduced-price lunch application process, including validating forms and running income verification process.

**Leadership & Management**

* Exhibit Rocketship’s core values daily: authenticity, community, innovation, tenacity, and pursuit of excellence.
* Hire, manage, and evaluate all hourly school Operations Specialists. Drive Operations Specialist satisfaction and development through active investment in your team.
* Be a collaborative and supportive partner on your school’s leadership team and the national Business Operations Manager team.
* Engage with parents on operational topics, demonstrating a clear customer service mindset that honors and engages our students’ families.
* Have the opportunity to be the campus COVID Lead as we navigate and adapt our staff and student facing procedures to ensure our campuses mitigate the risk of COVID-19

### **Required Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, with school-based experience strongly preferred. Many of our most successful BOMs have previously been teachers and/or school leaders in other roles.

Meta is seeking a Global Supply Chain Operations Manager to drive end-to-end supply chain execution for hardware programs supporting Meta's portfolio of consumer devices, data center infrastructure, and emerging technologies including virtual reality, augmented reality, and wearable platforms. * Drive multi-source supply strategies and qualification of alternate suppliers to improve supply chain resilience across critical component categories
* Collaborate with demand planning, logistics, and operations teams to align supplier capacity commitments and lead time targets with product ramp schedules and volume forecasts
* Develop and communicate commodity roadmaps and supply chain strategies to cross-functional partners and organizational leadership, influencing sourcing decisions at scale

* Experience collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, quality engineering, new product introduction, and finance teams to align sourcing decisions with product and business requirements
* Experience developing and presenting commodity strategies, supply risk analyses, and supplier performance reports to cross-functional stakeholders

jobs.title: Supply Chain & Operations Manager (North America)
jobs.description:
**About UnitX**
---------------

UnitX is building the AI-powered eyes and brain for autonomous manufacturing. Our machine-vision platform helps manufacturers detect complex defects, automate inspection, and improve production quality in applications where conventional vision systems fall short.

We are expanding into emerging, high-growth markets—including AI data-center infrastructure and next-generation AI hardware—and are looking for a business development leader to help establish UnitX as a strategic partner to the companies defining these industries.

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for a hands-on Supply Chain & Operations Manager to own how hardware moves through UnitX in North America. You'll make sure every part we buy arrives on time, every system we ship is right the first time, and every dollar and asset is accounted for. You'll work closely with Engineering, Field Deployment, Finance and Sales, and you'll be comfortable both negotiating with vendors and testing hardware at the bench.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Run domestic and international receiving and shipping for customer orders and internal hardware/software, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs documents and export compliance
* Bench-test incoming and outgoing hardware (power-on, imaging, camera/lens checks); triage failures with Engineering before shipment
* Own procurement for hardware (GPUs, industrial PCs, cameras, lenses, cables, lighting) and software licenses, from quotes and POs through approvals, renewals and cost tracking
* Manage vendor performance: track lead times and on-time delivery, resolve late or defective shipments and keep an approved vendor list
* Build and run inventory and asset management: system of record, cycle counts, reconciliation, asset tagging and RMAs
* Manage import and export compliance: classify products (HTS, ECCN), calculate duties, tariffs and landed cost, work with customs brokers, file export documents and keep records audit-ready
* Own the monthly operations dashboard (on-time delivery, shipment errors, spend vs budget, inventory accuracy); write and maintain SOPs; work with Sales and Field teams on demand and delivery planning; lead process improvement across NA operations
* Run the office, warehouse and lab space: layout, security, safety and EHS compliance, office supplies, facility vendors; Set up laptops and accounts, manage license seats, handle first-line hardware and network issues as needed

**What you'll bring**
=====================

* 5+ years in supply chain, operations or procurement at a hardware company
* Comfort assembling, powering on and troubleshooting computers, GPUs, cameras and cabling
* Hands-on experience shipping high-value products domestically and internationally (Incoterms, HTS codes, commercial invoices, export controls)
* Working knowledge of import and export duties and customs: tariff classification, duty and tariff impacts, customs broker management
* A record of buying both hardware and software licenses, including negotiating price and lead time
* Experience owning inventory and asset tracking in an ERP or inventory system (NetSuite, Odoo or similar) with high count accuracy
* Strong organization and follow-through; you like clean data and clear processes
* Able to work on-site in our Milpitas office, 5 days a week

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience at a machine vision, industrial automation, robotics or AI hardware company
* Experience building operations processes from scratch at a startup
* Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers
* Bilingual in Mandarin is a plus

**Why Join UnitX**
==================

This role offers the opportunity to accelerate human productivity through robotics in manufacturing. You get to define how a differentiated AI-vision platform enters some of the world’s fastest-growing and most strategically important manufacturing markets. You will work directly with company leadership, influence product and market strategy, and build relationships that can become significant global accounts.

*UnitXis proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We value diversity, inclusion, and respect, and are committed to building a workplace where everyone can thrive. We make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.*

*We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities during the application and hiring process. If you require assistance, please contact Human Resources. Requests for accommodation will be treated confidentially and in accordance with applicable laws.*

*As a safety-sensitive, drug-free workplace, employment with UnitX is contingent upon successful completion of applicable pre-employment screening requirements.*

Compensation Range: $112K - $145K

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future.

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

The Operations Manager (OM) is responsible for the direct or indirect oversight and coordination of all operational functions in the Bay Area (San Jose and Oakland) grouping, resulting in a well-functioning, compliant operational environment. The Operations Manager serves as the primary liaison for HQ Regional Functional Leads including Supply Chain Advisor (SCA), Regional Safety & Security Director (RSSD), Regional IT Director (RITD) and Global Facilities Director (GFD). This position reports to the Executive Director and oversees the Operations staff in both offices. This position is based in either San Jose or Oakland, with regular weekly onsite presence within both offices.

**Major Responsibilities:**

**Safety & Security—S&S:**

* Oversee regional S&S matters.
* Responsible for the implementation and maintenance of all office S&S documentation.
* Organize all-staff S&S meetings at office or program site.
* Ensure that a minimum of one emergency evacuation is exercised at office or program site level per year and other appropriate trainings informed by Security Risk Assessment findings.
* Cascade HQ and/or office security warnings and advisories to staff, interns, and volunteers as needed.
* Report all S&S incidents involving covered persons in accordance with established protocols.
* Coordinate immediate incident management including filing police reports.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with other S&S actors or stakeholders, including but not limited to community organizations and partners, authorities, security and rescue services, and property owners.
* Assist in the development of office-specific S&S onboarding materials, ensuring the provision of S&S briefings to new staff and covered persons.

**Supply Chain—SC:**

* Serve as the region’s primary focal point for procurement, asset and inventory management, in-kind donations tracking and reporting, vehicle fleet management and transportation, and warehousing in accordance with established organizational and donor requirements.
* Lead the bidding process, including request for quotation process, request for proposal process, tender evaluation, and facilitating procurement committee functioning.
* Manage relationships with suppliers and vendors.
* Maintain up-to-date supplier and service provider records. Maintain asset register and inventory lists of purchased and donated items. Establish and manage inventory control for office supplies, stationery, and other consumables. In collaboration with the Finance Manager, ensure inventories reconcile with financial reports.
* Support program teams in meeting their match goals.
* Ensure policy compliance for the fleet of IRC-owned vehicles and oversee their maintenance and usage.
* Working with HQ Supply Chain to maintain IRC policy at all the times.
* Control and maintain the IRC policy through the PO system in Integra.

**Facilities Management:**

* Manage the region’s office and equipment leases, coordinate repairs and improvements with property managers, and lead the procurement of office equipment.
* Coordinate the allocation of workspaces and support related employee lifecycle needs such as building access.
* Support smooth functioning of office infrastructure including communications equipment and services.
* Assist with planning and coordinating office events and meetings.
* Responsible for coordinating on- and off-site storage needs.
* Maintain NorCal’s status with all counties related to annual property’s tax along with exemption status.

**Information Technology—IT:**

* Oversee grouping IT and communications infrastructure, hardware and software matters.
* Educate staff about IT support resources, including appropriate channels for incident reporting.
* Work with regional and HQ IT team to address any internet or telecommunications service disruptions, liaising with local internet and telecommunications service providers.
* Escalate any unresolved incidents or larger-scale IT projects (such as office moves or expansion) as needed.
* Ensure compliance with IT protocols, policies, and procedures including information security policy, IT procurement and asset management policy, acceptable use of IT resources policy, and new software procurement protocols.

**Other Duties**

* Provide mentorship and supervision to Operations staff, including leading team meetings, individual supervision and coaching, and conducting goal setting, and performance reviews.
* Approve Integra vendor creations and invoice journals.
* Coordinate with the Finance Director to manage administrative expenses and reports.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Key Working Relationships:**

* **Position reports to:** Executive Director
* **Position directly supervises:** Front Desk staff, Operations staff

**Job Requirements:**

* Undergraduate degree in business, non-profit management, public administration, or others related field preferred
* At least five years of related professional experience; preferably with refugee services and in a non-profit or social service environment
* Experience supervising staff preferred
* Demonstrated ability to work with deadlines and lead multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

**LiveX AI · Project Manager**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, on-site · Department: Operations / Deployments · Reports to: founding team  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/project-manager (posted Jul 24, 2026)

### **About the Role**

LiveX AI builds AI infrastructure for the physical world, deploying interactive AI agents and hardware into high-foot-traffic venues such as hotels, retail flagships, convention centers, and stadiums. Each deployment is custom and requires sales, solution engineering, warehouse readiness, and a third-party delivery partner to stay in sync. This role owns each deployment end to end and works daily with sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics.

### **Responsibilities**

**End-to-End Deployment Ownership**

* Single accountable owner for each deployment, from signed contract to a live, working installation at the customer site.
* Run the deployment schedule: define milestones, sequence dependencies, track status, surface risks and blockers early.
* Internal hub across sales, solution engineering, and office/logistics so nothing falls between teams.

**Scope & Solution Engineering**

* Drive a clear, complete SOW from sales and sales engineering before each deployment starts; push back when scope is ambiguous.
* Track solution engineers through implementation against the SOW, keeping configuration and readiness on schedule.
* Translate customer requirements and site constraints into a concrete deployment plan.

**Logistics & Warehouse Coordination**

* Coordinate with the office/logistics owner and the third-party delivery partner on delivery windows, pickup, and destination readiness.
* Confirm warehouse readiness before each deployment: items staged, configured, health-checked before shipping.
* Manage installation scheduling and any returns or de-installations.

**Customer & Communication**

* Customer-facing point of contact during rollout: set expectations, communicate timelines, manage change requests.
* Run deployment kickoffs and post-deployment reviews; capture lessons; feed improvements into the playbook.
* Report deployment status and the pipeline of upcoming installs to the founding team.

**Process & Systems**

* Build and maintain the deployment playbook, checklists, and tracking so the process is repeatable and scalable.
* Own the tooling that tracks deployment status, asset location, and readiness across the fleet.

### **Requirements**

* Hungry, startup mindset above all: thrives in ambiguity, moves fast, takes extreme ownership, does what it takes to make each install land.
* 3+ years in project management, implementation/deployment management, technical program management, or field-services coordination, ideally at a startup, hardware, or solutions company.
* Proven ability to run multi-stakeholder projects on a schedule and hold others accountable without direct authority.
* Comfortable reading and reasoning about a technical scope of work; talks credibly with solution engineers.
* Strong coordination and communication across internal teams, external partners, and customers.
* Highly organized and self-directed; builds process from scratch.
* Calm under pressure; biased toward closing gaps and driving at-risk deployments to resolution.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience deploying hardware or physical installations into venues or field sites.
* Familiarity with project/deployment tracking tools and a CRM (e.g., HubSpot).
* Background in logistics, shipping, or warehouse operations.
* PMP or similar credential (not required).

Not listed.

Email resume and relevant supporting materials to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Project Manager".

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------

At the County of Marin, our employees overwhelmingly report feeling their work is meaningful, they like the work they do, and they are proud to tell people, “I work for the County of Marin.” Discover more about us, our values and our organizational culture on the Department of Human Resources website. Read on to find out more about this opportunity.

**About the Information Service and Technology (IST) Department****:** Connecting our community and local government through innovative, accessible technology solutions.

* **Customers:** Enable departments through partnerships, responsiveness, and innovation; prioritizing their needs and fulfilling their expectations.
* **Solutions:** Be Innovative Business Leaders who identify opportunities early and apply technology to drive better, faster public services.

**Culture:** Cultivate leadership at all levels to drive IST’s success while advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. In addition to a full benefits package that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, Pension/Retirement, deferred compensation, and flexible spending accounts, we offer our employees:

* Hybrid (telework/onsite) work schedules.
* Options for Alternative Work Schedules (such as 4-5/9’s).
* A culture of public service collaboration and work/life balance.
* Training and career development opportunities.
* County benefits such as Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and Tuition Assistance Program (TAP).

  
**Remote Work Options:** The IST Department has embraced a hybrid work schedule that recognizes some duties of this position may be performed remotely. Candidates must be able to work**a minimum of** **three (3) days per week in the office**and report to County facilities for meetings, work assignments, and/or disaster service work upon short notice, as needed and deemed appropriate. During the initial probationary period, the successful candidate may be required to work primarily onsite before establishing a hybrid work schedule.  
  

**About the Project Management Office Team:** Our team provides centralized IT project management for technology-related projects across all County departments. We use standard project management principles, processes, tools, and software to ensure consistent project delivery approach and success.

**ABOUT THE POSITION**
----------------------

**We currently have one (1) full-time vacancy for a Senior IT Project Manager (County Classification: Senior Systems Engineer) in the Project Management Office (PMO) of the Information Services and Technology (IST) department.** The primary function of this assignment is senior-level IT project management, not hands-on systems engineering.

This is an opportunity for a Senior IT Project Manager to manage and deliver significant IT projects and contribute to how technology projects are delivered across Marin County, while supporting innovation, collaboration, and improved public outcomes.

Reporting to the IT Manager of PMO, the Senior IT Project Manager works with a team of IT professionals to manage health and delivery of IT projects across all methodologies (agile, hybrid, waterfall) with varied technology applications. They are responsible for all phases of the project lifecycle, stakeholders, project documentation, serve as technical specialists, operate independently with minimal supervision and provide mentorship to junior team members when needed. They also contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO Program through developing, updating and documenting project management policies, standards and guidelines to align with organizational goals.

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------

The ideal candidate has senior project management experience and has previously served in a project management office. This individual has managed the implementation of IT projects independently, throughout the project lifecycle, across all project methodologies, with a proven track record of successful implementations. They possess strong knowledge of project management and technical understanding to effectively lead technology projects, collaborate with technical teams, evaluate risks and dependencies, and communicate technical considerations to business stakeholders. They should have experience of mentoring team members, manage customer interactions and engage with diverse groups of stakeholders. Strong interpersonal skills are expected for cross functional collaboration with stakeholders across the organization and external parties.

Specifically, they are experienced in the following:

* All aspects of technology project management lifecycle across project methodologies (waterfall, hybrid and agile) while adhering to departmental policies and standards.
* Proficient and have a proven track record in delivering projects on time and on budget.
* Mentoring project management professionals in a team environment.
* Building collaborative partnerships across business and technical teams.
* Experience of technology (including system design, integration, testing, deployment, lifecycle management, compliance and vendor management).
* Analyzing client needs and managing project plan and stakeholder alignment.
* Adaptable with strong problem-solving mindset to maintain project critical path, with escalations as appropriate.
* Engagement and negotiation with external vendors/consultants to meet business requirements (including contract construction and budget tracking).
* Providing reports and conducting presentations for project stakeholders.
* Using data, metrics, and dashboards to support project decision-making.
* Promoting innovation and modern service delivery practice to support collaboration and productivity in project management practices.
* Staying current and updated with Project Management Institute (PMI) best practices and making recommendations regarding advancements and changes.

  
Certifications such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or related credentials

jobs.title: Program Manager, Supply Chain Analytics
jobs.description:
**Job Type:** Full-Time l **Location:** San Francisco, CA l **Department:** AI Infrastructure Supply Chain l **Reporting to:** Director, Supply Chain Analytics | **Work Location Type:** #hybrid
  
  
IREN is a leading AI Cloud Service Provider, delivering large-scale GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s vertically integrated platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and data centers in renewable-rich regions across the U.S. and Canada.
  
  
The **Program Manager, Supply Chain Analytics** enables the modernization of IREN’s global supply chain systems and tools portfolio by turning data into decisions: forecasts, supplier risk signals, should-cost models, Clear to Build dashboards, and AI-assisted workflows that enable the Supply Chain team to scale. Reporting to the Director, Supply Chain Analytics & Engineering, this individual will shape the analysis, modeling and AI layer on top: framing the business question, building envisioning solutions, and applying LLM and agentic tools to supply chain work.
  
  
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way - responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

  

* Support cross-functional implementations of analytics, dashboards, and AI-based tools by program managing requirements across stakeholders.
* Own the recurring supply chain analytics output creation and execution: spend analysis, supplier performance scorecards, lead-time and on-time-delivery tracking, inventory health and transformation KPIs, built on the governed datasets the Data Engineer maintains.
* Frame business questions from procurement, planning, finance and capital projects as analytical problems, and deliver answers with clear recommendations, not just dashboards.
* Build and validate forecasting models for demand, lead times and delivery dates on long-lead equipment, and should-cost and price-trend models for key categories.
* Partner with Risk Manager to develop supplier-risk and delivery-risk AI-based tool/dashboard
* Prototype optimization and scenario models (inventory policy, allocation across sites, sourcing mix) and hand production-ready logic to the Data Engineer for deployment.
* Identify and deliver LLM and agentic use cases across the supply chain: extracting terms and specs from contracts, quotes and datasheets; summarizing and comparing RFx responses; supplier research and discovery; drafting supplier communications; triaging PO, invoice and shipment exceptions.
* Build these as repeatable tools with prompts, retrieval over internal documents, evaluation sets and human-in-the-loop checks, in line with IREN's AI and data-security policies.
* Partner with the Supply Chain Data Engineer on data requirements, definitions and quality issues surfaced by analysis; raise them early and specifically.

  

* Bachelor's degree in statistics, data science, engineering, economics, supply chain or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5+ years in analytics, data science or applied AI, with at least 2 years working on supply chain, procurement, operations or finance problems.
* Program management experience supporting multi-team and function implementations of tools, processes, or solutions.
  

  

* Strong understanding of supply chain processes, tools, stakeholder interactions, and processes and experience working with ERP/MRP, CLM, PLM, QMS tools
* Hands-on experience applying LLMs to business workflows: prompt design, retrieval-augmented generation over internal documents, evaluation of outputs, and building small tools or agents with current APIs and frameworks.
* Proficiency in a BI tool (Power BI, Tableau or Looker) and in designing metrics people trust.
* Working knowledge of supply chain processes – source-to-contract, procure-to-pay, planning, inventory, logistics – and the decisions each one turns on.
* Experience with procurement and supplier-risk platforms (Coupa, Ariba, Ivalua, Craft, Interos, Resilinc) or supply-market intelligence sources.
* Demonstrated experience building and validating forecasting or predictive models that were used in real decisions, and explaining their limits to non-technical audiences.
* Prefer experience in data center, AI infrastructure, energy, construction or other capital-project-heavy industries with long-lead equipment (GPUs, networking, transformers, switchgear, generators).

  
Other important requirements
  

* Pre-employment screening, including background check and substance testing may be required according to company policies.
* Must be able to reliably commute to the assigned office location on scheduled in-office days under the hybrid work arrangement.
* This role requires willingness to travel domestically and internationally to supplier and vendor sites, data centers, implementation partner locations, and industry events. IREN does not yet have an office in the Bay Area (a Santa Clara office is planned); until it opens, this role will work remotely, transitioning to hybrid on-site work once the office is established.

  

The IREN Package
  
At IREN, we offer a highly competitive compensation package that includes base salary, annual performance incentives, and opportunities to build long-term wealth through equity programs. These offerings are part of our broader Total Rewards package, thoughtfully designed to support your health, well-being, and long-term success.
  
Compensation
  

* The expected base salary for this role USD $190,000-$240,000/annum.
  + Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
* Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive

jobs.title: Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
LGTC Group, P.C. is a CARF-accredited, multi-site behavioral health organization providing evidence-based mental health services across outpatient, IOP, PHP, and residential levels of care throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We serve children, adolescents, and adults across Santa Clara County and beyond, with a multidisciplinary team committed to individualized, compassionate treatment that promotes lasting recovery and well-being.

**Job Overview**
----------------

The **Outpatient Therapy Operations Coordinator** is a pivotal operational role responsible for the day-to-day management of LGTC's outpatient therapy services across multiple locations. This position sits at the intersection of clinical operations and administrative systems — ensuring seamless scheduling, EHR compliance, credentialing coordination, regulatory adherence, and continuity of care for an active outpatient caseload.

The ideal candidate is operationally precise, comfortable with data, and able to work proactively across clinical, administrative, and leadership teams without requiring close supervision. Prior experience in behavioral health or healthcare operations is essential.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Scheduling & Calendar Management**

* Coordinate and maintain therapist calendars across all outpatient locations
* Manage scheduling for Group Therapy, Social Labs, and therapy provision at satellite locations (Oakland, Roseville, Willow St., San Bruno)

**EHR Administration & Compliance**

* Audit and oversee documentation completion in the electronic health record (EHR)
* Provide EHR technical support to clinical staff — including couples therapy charting, treatment plan templates, documentation workflows, and consent forms for specialized services (couples therapy agreements, MFT video recording, KAP meet-and-greet consents)
* Ensure form forwarding rules are correctly configured for associates and clinical supervisors
* Set up private pay agreements in EHR for clients assigned to interns
* Maintain website accuracy for associate therapist listings and supervisor information

**Credentialing & Staff Transitions**

* Proactively communicate associate therapist licensure status changes to initiate credentialing without delay
* Coordinate client coverage options during credentialing periods
* Ensure adherence to therapist offboarding and client transfer protocols to maintain continuity of care

**Case Management & Clinical Support**

* Provide ongoing case management for enrolled outpatient clients
* Support high-acuity cases in collaboration with clinical staff

**Data, Metrics & Reporting**

* Prepare reports and track program metrics including demand, capacity, and census
* Track therapist productivity and calculate bonuses
* Work with Informatics lead to track Kaiser MBC stats — conversion rates and time to intake/admission
* Track and follow up on therapist complaint inquiry forms
* Identify therapist hiring needs and growth opportunities based on demand data (in-person, virtual, specific modalities)

**Operations & Site Management**

* Coordinate multi-site furniture procurement and site setup
* Track site-level expense reports for therapy-related purchases across all locations
* Maintain regulatory and policy compliance documentation for CARF through SharePoint
* Identify and support process improvement initiatives

**Meetings & Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Facilitate and attend psychotherapist monthly and quarterly meetings
* Attend Ketamine Assisted Psychotherapy-specific weekly meetings
* Coordinate across departments and disciplines to support seamless outpatient operations
* Support staff training and onboarding

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree required
* Master's degree preferred in Healthcare Administration, Public Health, Psychology, or a related field
* Relevant behavioral health operations experience may substitute for advanced degree

**Core Competencies**

* **Operational precision** — manages complex, multi-site scheduling, documentation audits, and compliance workflows simultaneously without dropping details
* **Clinical operations fluency** — understands the intersection of clinical practice and administrative systems; supports EHR workflows, credentialing timelines, and continuity of care protocols independently
* **Proactive communication** — anticipates downstream impacts (licensure changes, offboarding, site gaps) and initiates coordination before problems surface
* **Data orientation** — tracks productivity metrics, census data, conversion rates, and bonus calculations; translates operational data into actionable recommendations
* **Cross-functional collaboration** — effective working across clinical, administrative, contracting, and leadership teams across multiple locations
* **Judgment under ambiguity** — able to support high-acuity cases and process improvement initiatives with minimal direction

**Benefits**
------------

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) retirement plan
* Paid time off (vacation, sick leave, and holidays)
* CEU/professional development support
* Collaborative, mission-driven work environment within a CARF-accredited organization

**Compensation & Work Location**
--------------------------------

**Pay:** Starting at $30 per hour, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

**Work Location:** In person — San Jose

*LGTC Group, P.C. is an equal opportunity employer committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace.*

**ABOUT THE PRACTICE**  
Dr. Rahul Seth is a double board-certified facial plastic and reconstructive surgeon and Director of Plastic Surgery  
for Golden State Plastic Surgery, a division of Golden State Dermatology. His practice focuses on facial  
feminization and masculinization surgery (FFS/FMS), rhinoplasty, and facial rejuvenation and facelift surgery. He  
has been in practice in the Bay Area for 13 years and has an established patient base and reputation. He serves as  
Medical Director of Callista Surgery Center and is a Volunteer Associate Clinical Professor at UCSF.  
You will join a small, close-knit team where every person’s work directly shapes how patients experience their  
care. We offer a collaborative, patient-centered environment, modern facilities, and strong clinical support.

For many of our patients, facial surgery is one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives. As Patient Care  
Coordinator for Dr. Rahul Seth, you will be the person who guides them through it, from their first  
consultation to their follow-up visits. If you take pride in getting the details right and love being the person  
patients and teammates can count on, we would like to meet you.

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**  

* Be the patient’s guide. Serve as the primary point of contact for surgical and cosmetic patients, building

trusted relationships from consultation through recovery.  

* Educate with clarity and care. Walk patients through recommended procedures, alternatives, risks, recovery

timelines, and what to expect after surgery.  

* Own the surgical calendar. Schedule surgeries, pre-operative appointments, and post-operative follow-ups

across our offices and surgical facilities.  

* Navigate insurance and costs. Verify coverage, help obtain authorizations, and help patients understand

their costs and payment expectations.  

* Build accurate quotes. Prepare clear, detailed surgical price quotes, including fees, timelines, and financing

options.  

* Close every loop. Coordinating with the clinical staff to make sure all pre-operative documentation, consents,

and clearances are complete and on time.  

* Support recovery. Coordinate post-operative instructions, follow-up visits, and ongoing patient

communication.  
**WHO YOU ARE**  

* Meticulous and dependable. You double-check your work, follow through without being reminded, and take

ownership when something needs fixing.  

* A true team player. You communicate proactively, pitch in where needed, and help create a positive,

supportive workplace with surgeons, nurses, and staff.

* A warm, trustworthy communicator. You are comfortable with sensitive conversations and treat every

patient, including transgender and nonbinary patients, with respect and genuine care.  

* Consultative, not pushy. You help patients move forward through education, trust, and ethical advocacy.
* Highly organized. You can manage many patients at different stages of care by utilizing our medical record

and technology solutions.  

* Experienced. Background in plastic surgery, dermatology, aesthetics, or healthcare is strongly preferred.

Experience with EMR systems such as ModMed EMA or eClinicalWorks is a plus.

* Mobile. Able to travel between our Walnut Creek (home base) and San Francisco (2 days per month).

**COMPENSATION & BENEFITS**  

* Competitive pay: $28–$38 per hour, based on experience.
* 40% off products and procedures, plus free annual injectable events
* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits
* Company-paid short- and long-term disability and life insurance
* Safe Harbor 401(k) with up to a 4% match
* PTO that accrues from your first day, plus 9 paid holidays (for employees working over 20 hours per pay

period)  

* Flexible spending accounts and commuter benefits
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) counseling
* Pet insurance
* Exclusive discounts on theme parks, attractions, hotels, concerts, and movie tickets

**Golden State Dermatology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and**  
**applicants for employment and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin,**  
**age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.**

**Golden State Dermatology participates in the E-Verify program. E-Verify is a free, web-based system that allows employers to confirm their**  
**employees’ eligibility to work in the United States. It does this by comparing information from an employee’s Form I-9, Employment Eligibility**  
**Verification, to records from the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) and Social Security Administration (SSA).**  
**GSD strongly encourages employees to receive the COVID-19 primary series vaccination.**

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Consultant
jobs.description:
**Position Overview :**
  
Our client in San Jose, CA, is seeking a Quality Assurance Consultant for a three-month engagement to support manufacturing compliance initiatives and remediation activities in preparation for an anticipated FDA inspection in early 2027.

The consultant will focus on addressing manufacturing deviations, CAPAs, and quality findings identified through internal facility and manufacturing line audits. Responsibilities may also include reviewing GMP batch records, evaluating documentation for compliance, and supporting efforts to ensure manufacturing operations are inspection-ready as the company advances toward a Biologics License Application (BLA).

The ideal candidate brings experience in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical manufacturing quality, deviation investigations, CAPA management.  
**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Review and address manufacturing deviations and CAPAs identified through internal audits of the facility and manufacturing operations.
* Support root cause investigations, develop corrective and preventive action plans, and assist with timely resolution of outstanding quality issues.
* Evaluate manufacturing processes and documentation to identify compliance gaps and opportunities for remediation.
* Review GMP batch production records for completeness, accuracy, adherence to procedures, and compliance with applicable quality requirements.
* Support the development, execution, and documentation of corrective actions to strengthen compliance.
* Partner with Quality Assurance, Manufacturing, and other cross-functional teams to resolve quality issues and ensure effective implementation of remediation activities.
* Maintain accurate, complete, and inspection-ready documentation of investigations, CAPAs, and related quality activities.
* Support inspection-readiness initiatives in anticipation of an FDA inspection expected between February and April 2027.
* Contribute to quality and compliance activities supporting the company's progress toward a BLA submission.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Experience in Quality Assurance, Quality Compliance, or Manufacturing Quality within the pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical industry.
* Hands-on experience investigating manufacturing deviations and managing CAPAs in a GMP-regulated environment.
* Experience reviewing batch records and manufacturing documentation.
* Strong investigation, documentation, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently, prioritize remediation activities, and deliver results within a defined contract period.

jobs.title: Partner Enablement Lead, Beneficial Deployments
jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------

Anthropic's Beneficial Deployments team brings Claude to organizations doing some of the world's most important work across the nonprofit and education sectors. These organizations share a problem: mission-critical work, thin budgets, and little slack to figure out new technology on their own. Our Customer Success team helps them go from first login to Claude being part of how their teams work, but we cannot do that one organization at a time, nor should we. The sector already has trusted intermediaries these organizations turn to first: networks, capacity builders, funder technical assistance providers, community colleges, and fellowship programs. This role exists to make those intermediaries as effective at activating and training organizations on Claude as our own Customer Success team is.

As the Scaled Enablement Lead, you'll build the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program that qualifies intermediaries to onboard organizations and deliver Anthropic-designed workshops on our behalf. You'll own the kits, credentials, and quality gates that let them run the show without an Anthropic CSM in the room. You'll also own the enablement thinking behind scaling impact through Claude Corps: how what fellows learn and build serves every organization we support, not only the ones that host them.

The people you enable are not selling Claude. They are trainers, implementers, and program staff whose job is to help mission-driven organizations meaningfully adopt AI. Your job is to make sure these intermediaries can do that with Claude, to the same bar we hold ourselves to, and to help them evolve their offerings as we learn what these organizations need. The measure of success for this role is organizations activated and trained well without Anthropic delivering it.

You'll be half program builder, half facilitator. You'll design and deliver the first cohorts yourself, then make the system repeatable: kits, qualification paths, credentials, teach-back gates, and a refresh rhythm that keeps content current as our products change. You'll build on the operating model and certification infrastructure of Anthropic's Education team and own everything specific to this audience, working closely with Beneficial Deployments Customer Success, Partnerships, Claude Corps program leadership, and our Education teams.

This is not a partner account management or alliances role, and it carries no quota. It is not a book-of-business Customer Success role either, though you'll spend time with organizations to stay grounded in what these nonprofits truly need. The role reports to the Customer Success Lead for Beneficial Deployments, has no direct reports today, and may grow into people management as the program scales. Expect periodic travel for in-person cohorts and sessions.

**Key responsibilities:**
-------------------------

* Own the Claude for Nonprofits train-the-trainer program end to end: its tracks, the qualification path for each, the credential, and recertification
* Build the kits intermediaries teach from: an activation playbook covering kickoff, admin setup, launch, and Day 30/60/90 reviews, and workshop-in-a-box modules starting with AI fluency and use case discovery, each with a deck, facilitator guide, demo scripts, sample data, and workbook
* Recruit and qualify a pilot cohort of anchor intermediaries, then open a repeatable application process that routes each to the right track and the right home, whether the Claude Partner Network or a Beneficial Deployments credential
* Design and deliver enablement for network intermediaries, adapting the program to how each reaches and supports its members, and help them evolve their offerings as we learn what organizations need
* Build the connective tissue among intermediaries so they learn from each other: shared office hours, a facilitator cohort that stays together after qualification, and a clear path for bringing new intermediaries along
* Support the enablement thinking for Claude Corps: how we extend the reach of fellows and the organizations around the program, and how what they learn feeds back into the enablement every customer receives

A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company.
