Additionally, you will work closely with our central compliance team, a community of experienced compliance leaders, to support an enterprise-wide culture of compliance and coordinate effective guidance across internal business units. At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation - driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Mintlify?**
=================

We're on a mission to empower builders.

* **Massive reach:** Our docs platform serves 100 million+ developers every year and powers documentation for 20,000+ companies, including Anthropic, Microsoft, PayPal, Spotify, Coinbase, X, and over 20% of the last YC batch.
* **Small team, huge impact:** We recently passed 65 employees and raised a $45 million Series B led by A16Z and Salesforce Ventures. Each new hire has a huge impact on shaping the company's trajectory.
* **Culture of** **slope over y-intercept****:** We value learning velocity, grit, and unapologetically unique personalities.

We grew in value faster than headcount and we’re looking to align the two quickly.

**About the role**
==================

We're hiring an Account Manager to grow Mintlify's relationships with a book of customers, each typically $50K–$250K in annual recurring revenue. You'll own the commercial side of these accounts: renewals, expansion, and pricing conversations. Customer Success owns adoption and the day-to-day relationship, and you'll work as one team with them.

Your job is to find where Mintlify can do more for each customer, such as another product team's docs, a help center, or growing AI usage, and turn it into growth. Our buyers are engineering, developer experience, and documentation leaders, so you'll need to be comfortable talking about how docs are built and shipped, even if you don't write code.

* **Team:** Account Management, working alongside Customer Success and our other Account Managers
* **Reports to:** Ben Terrill, Head of Customer Success
* **Location:** San Francisco, in office when you're not traveling
* **Travel:** About one trip per month for customer visits, business reviews, and events
* **Type:** Full-time, quota-carrying

**What you'll do**
==================

**Own and grow your book**
--------------------------

* Manage a book of accounts, each typically $50K–$250K ARR.
* In partnership with a CSM, build an account plan for each: stakeholders, contract terms, usage, and where we can grow.
* Support renewals end to end: forecast early, negotiate terms, and propose multi-year agreements where they fit.

**Find and close expansion with Customer Success**
--------------------------------------------------

* Partner with your CSMs to turn customer signals, such as new teams, new products, or rising AI usage, into qualified opportunities.
* Run discovery, build the business case, then negotiate and close: new sites for other products or business units, help centers and knowledge bases, AI credits, and add-ons.
* Right-size offers: sell the capability a customer needs instead of defaulting to the full bundle.

**Show up in person and go beyond your champion**
-------------------------------------------------

* Spend about one week a month with customers: on-site visits, executive business reviews, and industry events.
* Build relationships across engineering, developer experience, docs, and procurement, not just with your champion.

**Run a clean commercial process**
----------------------------------

* Keep Salesforce current: opportunities, stages, next steps, contacts, and renewal dates.
* Forecast renewals and expansion accurately 30, 60, and 90 days out.
* Bring customer feedback on pricing, packaging, and product gaps back to Product and leadership.
* Share what works with the Account Management team so the best plays become repeatable.

**What we're looking for**
==========================

* 3+ years in a quota-carrying account management role, or an AE role with expansion ownership, at a B2B SaaS company.
* A track record of growing mid-market or enterprise accounts ($50K+ ARR), with expansion numbers you can name.
* Moderate technical understanding: you can explain how a team writes, reviews, and publishes docs (Git, Markdown, APIs, CI/CD), hold your own with engineering leaders, and know when to bring in a Solutions Engineer.
* Strong discovery and negotiation skills, including renewals, multi-year terms, and working with procurement.
* Experience partnering with Customer Success, with clear ownership of the commercial relationship.
* Organized and data-driven: disciplined in Salesforce, accurate in forecasting, and able to read usage data to time an expansion.
* Willing to travel about one week a month.
* Able to work from our San Francisco office when you're not traveling.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* You've sold developer tools, API platforms, or other products bought by engineering teams.
* Experience with usage-based pricing, such as credits or overages.
* You've used Mintlify or another docs platform.
* Familiarity with AI products (AI search, assistants, MCP) and how teams adopt them.
* Early-stage startup experience, especially helping build an account management or expansion motion.

**What success looks like**
---------------------------

* **30 days:** You know your book (every account's contract, renewal date, usage, and key contacts), you've met your CSM partners and top customers, and you have a plan for each account.
* **90 days:** Every renewal in the next two quarters has a plan and a next step, you've made your first on-site visits, and your qualified expansion pipeline is growing.
* **6 months:** You're closing expansion every month, renewals land on time without surprises, and your forecast is reliable.
* **12 months:** You've hit your expansion number, your book grows net revenue year over year, and at least one play you built is used across the team.

**Company Benefits:**
=====================

* Competitive compensation and equity
* 20 days paid time off every year
* 401k with Employer Match
* monthly wellness stipend
* 100% employee coverage for Health, Dental, Vision
* Commute stipend to help get you to and from work
* Free lunch and dinners
* Annual team offsite (previously went to Alaska, Hawaii, Jackson Hole)

Compensation Range: $150K - $250K

jobs.description:
**LiveX AI · Recruiter / People Operations**  
Palo Alto, CA · Full-time, in-person · Department: People · Reports to: CEO  
Source: https://livex.ai/careers/recruiter-people-operations (posted Oct 6, 2026)

### **About LiveX AI**

LiveX AI builds human-AI interfaces for physical spaces. Its 4K full-body AI agents greet, guide, and sell in retail flagships, hotels, hospitals, airports, convention centers, and stadiums, on-prem or in the cloud, in 140 languages.

### **About the Role**

LiveX is growing across engineering, solutions, go-to-market, and operations, and hiring has outgrown what the founders can handle. This is the company's first dedicated People hire: no HR team, no existing processes. Own full-cycle recruiting for all open roles and the employee experience from offer acceptance through the first 90 days, plus clean exits. Roughly 70% recruiting / 30% onboarding and offboarding. Reports to the CEO, works with every hiring manager; a path to Head of People as the team grows.

### **Responsibilities**

**Recruiting (primary)**

* Run full-cycle recruiting for engineering (AI/ML, full-stack, hardware/edge), solution engineering, sales/GTM, and operations: intake, job posts, sourcing, screening, scheduling, debriefs, offers, closing.
* Proactively build pipeline via sourcing tools, referrals, university/new-grad programs, AI and robotics communities, and events such as NVIDIA GTC; do not wait for inbound.
* Run a fast, candidate-friendly process: structured interviews, scorecards, same-week feedback, weekly pipeline report for the founders.
* Set up and maintain the ATS and key hiring metrics: time-to-fill, pass-through rates, offer-accept rate, cost per hire.
* Manage agency and contract recruiters when used: negotiate terms, enforce quality, control spend.
* Work with founders on offers: leveling, base pay, commission and equity framing, closing candidates with competing offers.

**Onboarding & Offboarding**

* Own signed offer through day 90: offer letters, background checks, I-9 and E-Verify, new-hire paperwork, equipment/account setup with engineering, first-week schedules, 30/60/90-day check-ins.
* Keep the onboarding guide current; every new hire correctly set up in payroll, benefits, and the cap table on day one.
* Coordinate visa-related onboarding (H-1B, OPT/STEM OPT, TN) with outside immigration counsel: document collection, timelines, employee communication.
* Run offboarding: exit checklists, equipment/access recovery, final pay timing under California rules, exit interviews, documentation.
* Maintain accurate, compliant personnel files; point of contact for paperwork, benefits enrollment, and policy questions.

### **Requirements**

* 3–6 years of full-cycle recruiting, including in-house at an early-stage startup (seed to Series B, under ~50 employees).
* Experience hiring both software engineers and salespeople.
* Hands-on onboarding and offboarding end to end, including I-9 and new-hire compliance for California employees.
* Strong sourcing skills; comfortable cold-reaching senior ML engineers or enterprise AEs.
* Organized and systems-minded: builds processes, keeps ATS and personnel records clean without prompting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; often the first impression of LiveX for candidates.
* Discretion with compensation, equity, immigration, and personnel matters.
* Early-stage operator mindset; comfortable with no existing HR function.
* Able to work on-site in Palo Alto.

### **Nice-to-Haves**

* Recruiting for AI/ML, robotics, computer vision, or hardware roles.
* Hands-on with a modern ATS, HRIS/payroll platform, and cap-table software.
* Experience working with immigration counsel on employment visa cases.

### **Compensation**

Base salary $110,000 – $150,000 per year, plus equity and benefits; placement depends on experience and skills.

### **How to Apply (original posting)**

Send a resume and a short note describing the hardest role you have closed to career@livex.ai, subject "Candidate Application - Recruiter / People Operations".

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

Compensation will be paid in the range of up to $50.00 - $60.00 per hour. Compensation to be determined by the applicant's knowledge, education, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

jobs.title: Office Manager
jobs.description:
**About the role**
------------------

We are a small team working on non-invasive brain-computer interfaces, starting with a headset that helps turn thought into text. It's early, hard research, and we're working on it together in San Francisco.

That work happens in our San Francisco office: research, engineering, and the data collection sessions that train our models. We're hiring our first Office Manager to run it, full-time and in person.

**Why this role matters to us**
-------------------------------

We're a team that takes pride in operational excellence. When the office runs well, researchers stay focused, participants have a great experience, and new teammates are productive on day one. When it doesn't, everything slows down.

This role is what keeps it running well. We treat it as core to the company, and you'll work directly with the founding team.

At its heart, this role is about care. You'll get to know the people here, notice what they need, and look after the space as if it were your own. If making a place feel welcoming and well run is something you take pride in, we'd love to meet you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Run the office**

* Keep food, snacks, and supplies stocked, and set up a simple way for people to request things.
* Manage cleaning, vendors, inventory, and device tracking.
* Own upkeep of the space: furniture, internet, utilities, keys and building access, air and temperature.

### **Take care of the team**

**Who you are**
---------------

* Proactive. You notice things before they become problems, and you'd rather fix something than report it.
* Warm and caring. People are glad when you walk in, and you treat everyone the same, from visitors to the CEO.
* Proud of your work. You care about the details, including the parts of the job that feel small.

* Offer

jobs.title: Product Operations | General Builder (All Levels)
jobs.description:
**About Ramp**
==============

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

**About the Role**
==================

Ramp is looking for ambitious generalists who want to turn difficult customer and business problems into better products and better ways of working.

In Product Operations, you will own a problem space from investigation through execution and measurement. You might uncover why customers abandon a workflow, build an AI tool that removes hours of manual work, or help a product team bring a new capability to customers. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and customer-facing teams, combining analytical rigor with the willingness to do the work yourself.

This role is designed for people who want substantial responsibility. You will build customer understanding, product judgment, technical fluency, and the ability to lead across teams. Strong performance can create opportunities for broader ownership in Product Operations, Product Management, Business Operations, or AI Operations, depending on your strengths and Ramp’s needs. Growth comes from sustained impact, demonstrated readiness, and available opportunities.

***\*Please note that this Product Operations role will require you to be comfortable with working in-person at our NYC HQ (located near Madison Square Park) at least 2 days/week\****

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Ramp moves incredibly fast, and our specific Product Operations needs change regularly. Each Product Operations team member is assigned to a specific product, such as Bill Pay, Procurement, or Travel. Ramp moves incredibly fast, and our specific Product Operations needs change regularly. During the hiring process, we will discuss which product areas are hiring priorities and where you could make the greatest impact.

  + **Own customer and operational outcomes.** Take responsibility for a defined problem, establish a baseline, and follow through until the experience improves.
  + **Find the underlying problem.** Combine customer conversations, operational observations, and data to distinguish recurring causes from isolated symptoms.
  + **Make clear recommendations.** Use your product sense and business acumen to size opportunities, compare tradeoffs, and help product partners decide where a process change, automation, or product investment will have the greatest effect.
  + **Build and improve workflows.** Create practical tools and automations, including AI-assisted solutions, that reduce repetitive work and improve reliability. Validate outputs and measure whether people actually benefit.
  + **Bring changes into use with empathy.** Own operational readiness, internal enablement, feedback collection, and follow-through after a launch or workflow change.
  + **Lead across teams.** Define metrics, establish owners, resolve dependencies, communicate decisions, and keep important work moving when the path is unclear.

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 2-6 years experience in banking, private equity, consulting, or in product management or business operations roles at a demanding startup. Level and compensation will be determined based on experience and qualifications.
* A record of taking personal ownership and delivering outcomes beyond the initial analysis or recommendation.
* Strong quantitative reasoning: you can work with messy data, check assumptions, and translate findings into a decision.
* Customer curiosity and practical judgment about which problems matter most and how to solve them. Willingness and instincts to go talk to a customer when something is unclear. Ability to prioritize well and work on the most important problems.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to earn trust for your arguments across technical and business teams.
* Resourcefulness, receptiveness to feedback, and evidence that you learn unfamiliar subjects quickly.
* Experience using AI tools to build something or improve a workflow, with a thoughtful approach to checking quality.

**Nice-to-Haves**
-----------------

* Experience building internal tools, using APIs or low-code platforms,
* Working with financial products, shipping software with AI assistance,
* Owning a launch can help you get started.
* We value the difficulty of the problems you have solved and the results you can explain.

**About Some of Our Teams:**

jobs.title: Program Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program Operations Coordinator**

**Position Summary**

Girls on the Run of Greater Sacramento is seeking a highly organized, relationship-focused professional who is passionate about youth development and creating positive experiences for girls, volunteers, and community partners.

The Program Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring Girls on the Run programs are delivered with excellence across the Greater Sacramento region. This position combines program operations, volunteer engagement, and relationship management to support every stage of our seasonal programs. From helping families navigate registration, to supporting volunteer coaches, to partnering with schools and community sites, this team member helps create the systems and relationships that allow our mission to thrive.

Working closely with the Program Lead and Executive Director, the Program Operations Coordinator serves as a key connector between participants, families, coaches, schools, and community partners. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoys building strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic nonprofit environment.

This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

**About the Role**

At Girls on the Run, successful programs are built through a combination of strong relationships and strong systems. This role helps ensure both are in place.

**Support Exceptional Program Delivery**

You will help create a seamless experience for participants and families from registration through the end of each season. This includes maintaining accurate participant information, supporting registration and scholarship processes, communicating with families, and ensuring program logistics are coordinated effectively.

Success in this area means families feel informed and supported, participant information is accurate, and program operations run smoothly throughout the season.

**Foster Meaningful Coach Relationships**

Volunteer coaches are the heart of Girls on the Run. In this role, you will help cultivate a positive experience for coaches by serving as a consistent point of contact, providing timely communication, answering questions, and connecting coaches with the resources they need to be successful.

You will play an important role in supporting coach recruitment, onboarding, engagement, and retention efforts while helping ensure coaches feel valued, prepared, and connected to our mission.

**Strengthen School and Community Partnerships**

Girls on the Run programs exist because of strong partnerships with schools and community organizations. You will help maintain and strengthen these relationships by serving as a responsive and professional partner to program sites throughout the region.

This includes communicating with school representatives, supporting site registration and planning processes, addressing questions and concerns, and helping identify opportunities to grow and strengthen partnerships over time.

You will help ensure our community partners have a positive experience working with Girls on the Run and understand the impact of the programs they help make possible.

**Manage Program Systems and Data**

As a primary user of the Girls on the Run program management platform, you will help ensure organizational data is accurate, current, and useful for decision-making.

This includes maintaining participant, coach, and site records; managing registration and roster information; generating reports; and supporting data-driven planning efforts. The ideal candidate enjoys creating order, solving problems, and using technology to support organizational success.

**Contribute to Organizational Growth and Continuous Improvement**

As a member of a small and collaborative team, you will have opportunities to contribute ideas, improve processes, and help strengthen the overall effectiveness of the organization.

We are seeking someone who is not only comfortable managing established systems but is also excited to identify new ways to improve efficiency, enhance stakeholder experiences, and support sustainable growth.

**What Success Looks Like**

Successful candidates will:

* Create positive experiences for participants, families, coaches, and site partners.
* Build strong relationships with schools, community organizations, and volunteers.
* Ensure program information and data are accurate, organized, and accessible.
* Communicate proactively and professionally with a variety of stakeholders.
* Anticipate needs and solve problems before they become barriers.
* Maintain strong attention to detail while managing multiple competing priorities.
* Contribute to a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and mission-driven work.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines independently.
* Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
* Comfort learning and utilizing technology platforms and databases.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment, maintain confidentiality, and manage sensitive information.
* Commitment to the mission and values of Girls on the Run.
* Reliable transportation for occasional local travel within the Greater Sacramento region.

**Preferred**

* Experience working with schools, youth-serving organizations, or nonprofit programs.
* Experience coordinating volunteers or volunteer-led programs.
* Experience with database, CRM, or registration management systems.
* Knowledge of community outreach, partnership development, or stakeholder engagement.
* Previous experience with Girls on the Run as a participant, coach, volunteer, or supporter.

**Position Details**

**Position Type:** Part-Time (approximately 20-30 hours per week)

**Location:** Hybrid/Remote within the Greater Sacramento region

**Schedule:** Flexible schedule with some evening and occasional wee

jobs.title: Global Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Global Business Operations Manager is aligned to an assigned zone comprising multiple countries and serves as the primary business liaison between global Commercial Excellence and zone and country organizations. The role ensures coordinated adoption, governance, and execution of CRM-related processes, sales operating standards, data governance requirements, and commercial initiatives across the zone.  
The GBOM partners with zone leaders and country-level roles to translate global standards into coordinated zone priorities and practical country execution, while ensuring common needs, local requirements, risks, and adoption barriers are represented in governance forums and transformation programs.  
The role steers execution across the assigned zone by aligning country plans, consolidating priorities and performance insights, reinforcing clear ownership and consistent operating routines, and coordinating cross-country action and escalation to achieve zone and country business goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Zone Operating Model & Country Execution**

* Translate global CRM business standards into a coordinated zone operating model and clear country-level execution expectations, including required fields, process steps, ownership rules, and reporting routines.
* Establish and maintain a zone governance cadence with zone and country stakeholders to review adoption, data quality, pipeline hygiene, forecasting discipline, priorities, dependencies, and open risks across assigned countries.
* Align country execution plans to zone priorities and global standards while documenting approved local deviations, rationale, owners, effective dates, and required approvals.
* Coordinate with zone leadership, country CRM support, Sales Operations, and Commercial Excellence teams to clarify handoffs, decision rights, accountability, and shared actions required to achieve zone and country goals.

**Zone Governance & Country Representation**

* Serve as the primary Commercial Excellence representative for an assigned zone and its constituent countries.
* Act as the key point of contact connecting global CRM and governance organizations with zone leaders and designated country-level roles.
* Coordinate communication and deployment of global commercial policies, governance standards, and process changes across the zone, supporting consistent execution in each country.
* Consolidate country feedback, adoption barriers, business risks, and local requirements into a zone perspective for representation in global governance forums.
* Maintain visibility to zone objectives and country priorities, readiness, performance, decision needs, and implementation dependencies; coordinate action plans and escalations with the appropriate zone and country owners.

**CRM & Process Adoption**

* Drive adoption of standardized sales processes and CRM practices.
* Monitor adherence to opportunity management, customer engagement, forecasting, and funnel management standards.
* Partner with zone commercial leadership and country sales leaders to address adoption gaps, process compliance issues, and shared performance goals.

**CRM Data Quality & Pipeline Discipline**

* Monitor completeness, accuracy, timeliness, and consistency of key CRM data fields across the assigned zone and its countries.
* Partner with zone and country teams to resolve duplicate records, inactive or expired funnel, missing ownership, territory mismatches, and other CRM data quality issues.
* Reinforce standards for account ownership, territory alignment, opportunity stage progression, close-date maintenance, forecasting inputs, and customer engagement documentation.
* Coordinate zone and country action plans to improve pipeline hygiene and enable reliable business reviews, forecasting, and commercial performance reporting.

**Business Requirements Management**

* Collect, consolidate, and document zone-wide and country-specific business requirements.
* Assess alignment among country needs, zone priorities, and global standards, identifying opportunities for common solutions across countries.
* Coordinate zone-level prioritization and escalation of enhancement requests with country stakeholders.
* Coordinate review and approval of zone- and country-driven process changes.

**Exception & Change Control Management**

* Manage intake, triage, and documentation of country exception requests related to CRM processes, business rules, data standards, and operating procedures.
* Assess business impact, cross-country scalability, compliance considerations, and downstream reporting implications before escalating exceptions for approval.
* Maintain traceability of approved deviations and ensure they are reviewed periodically for continued relevance or harmonization back to the global standard.

**Zone & Country Readiness and Change Management**

* Coordinate rollout of CRM capabilities, governance initiatives, and business process changes across the assigned zone.
* Work with zone and country stakeholders to coordinate training, communication, and awareness activities.
* Monitor readiness across the zone and identify country-level gaps, dependencies, and support needs for new capabilities and transformations.
* Confirm country readiness against defined launch criteria and consolidate the results into a zone readiness view, including data readiness, business owner assignment, process documentation, training completion, and support model alignment.
* Coordinate post-launch stabilization with zone and country roles by tracking issue volume, adoption gaps, training needs, and open decisions

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Manager
jobs.description:
Big Blue Marble Academy (BBMA) is an early childhood development and education leader with more than 90 schools across 9 states. Our programs include early care, childcare, preschool, and after-school care designed around what a child needs for their age and stage of development. Our curriculum is focused on global education and teaching children the importance of giving back and helping others in need. We the structure and encouragement children need to foster their curiosity and love of learning. Our teachers provide children with hands-on activities preparing them for success in school.

**Quality Assurance Manager Job Description**

The Quality Assurance Manager (QA) plays a critical role in risk prevention, safety and compliance, all of which help ensure operational excellence across BBMA’s portfolio of schools. Working in connection with school management and higher levels of BBMA Operations, this position plays a critical role in “left-of-loss” risk prevention, and ensuring ongoing compliance with safety, and regulatory initiatives while driving consistency, quality, and continuous improvement to ensure each school meets and exceeds BBMA’s standards.

The QA Manager works collaboratively across departments to ensure schools feel fully supported as they enhance overall operational quality, fostering a culture of accountability, partnership, and continuous growth.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and execute quality assurance audits across all locations identifying compliance gaps

* Predict and prevent risks before they materialize

* Establish and track KPIs and report trends and build early-warning systems and predictive models related to quality, compliance and service delivery

* Partner proactively with all levels of BBMA Operations to ensure assigned schools operate in compliance with federal, state, and local laws, and childcare licensing regulations - evaluate performance against standards

* Develop, train, implement, and maintain standard operating procedures and best practices - develop risk-awareness culture and scenario-based readiness

* Monitor adherence to company policies, safety standards, and licensing requirements

* Identify opportunities to improve consistency, efficiency, and overall school performance

* Analyze operational and other data to drive improvements in quality

* Support all levels of BBMA Operations through coaching and ongoing development

* Create and manage training content within the Learning Management System (LMS)

* Conduct regular site visits (60-75% travel) to evaluate school performance

* Identify recurring issues and partner with leadership to implement sustainable solutions

* Develop and manage auditing tools, reporting systems, and tracking processes

* Review parent and staff feedback to improve service quality and experience

* Prepare detailed reports on audit findings, trends, and improvement plans

* Communicate insights and recommendations to senior leadership and other key stakeholders

* Collaborate cross-functionally to ensure alignment and successful implementation of initiatives

* Lead special projects related to quality, compliance, and operational improvements

* Maintain confidentiality of all company information and data

**Educational and Experience Requirements**

* A Bachelor’s degree with a preference for an additional certification in Certified Risk Management Professional (CRMP), Risk Management Professional (RMP), Certified Materials & Resource Professional (CMRP), Certified Safety and Health Manager (CSHM), OSHA Safety and Health Fundamentals, Certified Risk Manager (CRM) and similar certifications

* Background in building early-warning or predictive analytics systems

* Minimum of five (5) years of risk management and quality assurance experience which may be with combined operations experience, preferably in multi-site environments

* Preferred knowledge of childcare licensing regulations and compliance standards

* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills

* High proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data analysis)

* Experience with quality assurance systems, databases, and reporting tools

* Proven ability to manage multi-site projects and drive results

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with strong attention to details

* Takes initiative and completes tasks autonomously while maintaining quality standards

* Able to travel regularly to support business needs

  

A career with Big Blue Marble Academy will empower you to reach your career goals while making a difference in the lives of the children we serve.

  

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of our background check, pre-hire screenings, and onboarding processes. All employment is at-will and may be terminated at any time, with or without cause.

  

BBMA is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse workforce. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Contact us at recruiting@bbmacademy.com

**Data Insights & Operations Manager**

Location: Remote within the United States

#### **ABOUT ANET**

Achievement Network (ANet) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to helping all students achieve strong educational outcomes. We partner with school and system leaders to strengthen teaching and learning through the strategic use of assessments, coaching, and tools that drive meaningful results. Individuals who join ANet become part of a dynamic, mission-driven, and collaborative organization focused on making a lasting impact in schools. We are committed to supporting one another and growing together as a team.

#### **THE OPPORTUNITY**

This is an Exempt, Full-Time role, expected to work approximately 40 hours per week.

Reporting to the Senior Vice President, Partner Insights & Operations, the Data Insights & Operations Manager will lead how ANet turns data into insights that school and system leaders use to make decisions. Insights is one of ANet’s biggest bets: data is only as valuable as the insights drawn from it, and this role makes sure decision makers can make meaning of relevant data quickly and at scale.

The Data Insights & Operations Manager will be responsible for shaping and leading the production of insights for our partners, and ensuring there is the right data to create those insights through cross functional collaboration.

#### **TRAVEL**

Approximately 2 times a year

#### **RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Lead the production of standardized and partner insights**

* Shape and execute the approach for content and delivery of partner insights - standardized and partner specific
* Ensure clear roles and responsibilities for production and distribution of insights
* Review qualitative and quantitative data alongside the team to ensure insights are achieving intended outcomes
* Identify opportunities to build efficiency, precision, and actionability into partner insights (standardized and partner specific)
* Pilot other approaches to insight generation and visualization aimed at scaling standardized insight delivery
* Build efficiency, precision and actionability into insights, and pilot new approaches to generation and visualization (including AI) to scale delivery without proportional headcount.

**Ensure the right data exists to produce those insights**

* Partner with Product, Partner Experience & Impact, Design & Innovation, Marketing and Sales so insight needs are reflected in what’s collected and how systems connect.
* Define and maintain ownership, access and quality standards for the data that feeds insights.

jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**

**Aegis Ventures** is a next-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.

### **About the Company**

**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.

Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.

In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide. Optain also acquired EyePACS, a teleophthalmology platform with a 15-year history and an established network of licensed optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for diabetic retinopathy screening.

### **About the Job**

As the **Clinical Operations Manager**, you will own the operations of Optain's provider network - the optometrists and ophthalmologists who read retinal images for health systems, clinics, and community health centers across the United States. The network has run for 15 years on the judgment and relationships of a small number of people. Your job is to turn that into documented policy, a measurable quality program, a capacity model that runs ahead of demand, and a governance rhythm in alignment with Optain’s Medical Director. You will report to the VP of Operations and work day to day with Optain's Medical Director. This is a non-clinical role for someone who has managed a network of contracted clinicians before, writes policy that physicians sign, and knows the difference between running a process and building one that doesn't need you.

Optain is at an inflection point. We have FDA clearance, a growing camera footprint, and a commercial pipeline that is moving fast. Behind every screening exam is a licensed grader reading the images through our EyePACS platform, and the operational infrastructure around that network is being built in real time. This role sits at the center of that work.

This is a remote, US-based position.

### **What You'll Do**

Own the grading playbook, SOPs, onboarding materials, and the provider network policy library

* - author, version, and maintain them, and route clinical content to the Medical Director for review and sign-off.
Establish documentation governance for the network - ownership, versioning, review cadence, and sign-off* - so operating knowledge lives in documents rather than in individuals.
Design and run the grader quality program, including sampling, over-read and discordance review, turnaround accountability, and performance feedback* - establish error rates and trends where today review is periodic and manual.
* Prepare quality reviews and escalations for Medical Director adjudication and carry out the resulting actions, including performance conversations and offboarding.
* Build and maintain a capacity model by state, customer, and license coverage, and set recruitment triggers ahead of turnaround breaches.
* Run the grader recruitment pipeline from sourcing through interview and recommendation, working with the Operations Manager on credentialing and onboarding execution.
Own intake, triage, and routing of customer and grader complaints, including urgent findings workflows* - route clinical questions to the Medical Director, close the loop with the customer, and trend issues over time.
* Set the agenda, prepare decisions, and follow through so the Medical Director's time goes to clinical judgment rather than logistics.
* Partner with Product and Engineering on platform improvements that reduce manual work, including documenting current-state workflows so feature development is accurate and fast, and contribute network measurables to the weekly grader operations rhythm and company scorecard.

### **What You'll Need**

5+ years in healthcare operations, with 2+ years managing a network of contracted or affiliated clinicians

* - telehealth, teleradiology, or virtual care strongly preferred over traditional medical group or IPA settings.
* Has written clinical or operational policy that a physician leader signed, and maintained it afterward.
* Has run or materially contributed to a clinical quality, peer review, or provider performance program.
* Prior experience operating a clinician network under a medical director's clinical oversight is a strong plus.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
Bamboo Health is the leader in Real-Time Care Intelligence™ solutions aimed at improving lives for everyone experiencing physical and behavioral health challenges. We are driven by our mission to empower clients to deliver seamless, high-quality and cost-effective care during pivotal moments to improve health outcomes. From coast to coast, Bamboo Health partners with all major retail pharmacy chains, 52 states and territories, 100% of the top 10 best hospitals and more than half of the country’s largest health plans to improve more than 1 billion patient encounters annually. Join us in improving lives during pivotal care moments!

**Summary:**

Bamboo Health is building a team of compassionate clinicians and leaders who are committed to improving care access to those in most need. We are seeking a seasoned, highly motivated Senior Project Manager who can bridge clinical, operational, and technical workstreams across provider and payor organizations. This role owns end-to-end project delivery—from initial scoping through go-live and post-launch stabilization—while consulting directly with customers on workflow design to drive results and accelerate implementation timelines. In addition to leading individual implementations, you will manage a portfolio of partner engagements, balancing competing priorities, risks, and stakeholder needs while helping scale implementation best practices across the organization. The ideal candidate brings a strong mix of project management and client success experience, deep healthcare delivery knowledge, and the judgment to work independently with minimal oversight, comfortably tailoring communication across a variety of stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

**What You’ll Do:**

  

* Own the full implementation lifecycle for new provider or payor partners, working independently and with minimal oversight to ensure all milestones, deliverables, and outcomes are met on time and within scope.
* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for external partners, including health systems, provider networks, and payors.
* Partner with customers and internal clinical and operational teams to design workflows, staffing models, referral pathways, and escalation processes that support successful implementation and accelerate time to value.
* Collaborate with data integration and IT teams to enable connectivity with EHRs, care management platforms, and analytics tools.
* Guide partners through workflow changes, training, and adoption planning to drive results and ensure smooth go-live transitions.
* Maintain project plans and status reports, as well as risks and issues logs.
* Tailor communication of progress, dependencies, and mitigation plans across audiences, from junior project managers to executive leadership, both internally and externally.
* Capture lessons learned and feedback to refine implementation methodology, mentor less experienced project managers, and accelerate future rollouts.
* Manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, balancing timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder priorities to ensure successful delivery.
* Identify repetitive tasks and partner with team leads to implement scalable automation solutions.

**What Success Looks Like…**

**In 3 months…**

* Take ownership of at least one active implementation, serving as the primary customer contact while maintaining accurate status reporting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.
* Build strong relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, or implementation efficiency.
* Identify at least one opportunity in your role to pilot or apply AI or automation (e.g., streamlining a task, summarizing data, generating content).

**In 6 months…**

* Independently manage a portfolio of concurrent implementations, consistently delivering key milestones on time and within scope.
* Lead partners through workflow design, operational readiness, training, adoption planning, and go-live execution.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to customers while mentoring less experienced project managers and contributing implementation best practices across the team.

**In 12 months…**

* Deliver multiple successful go-lives with measurable post-launch stabilization, such as partner adoption targets met and time to value shortened compared with baseline.
* Capture lessons learned across your implementations and contribute at least two lasting improvements to our implementation playbook, templates, or tools.
* Be recognized as a go-to leader for complex implementations, influencing customer outcomes, supporting executive-level partner relationships, and helping elevate implementation excellence across the organization.

**What You Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of combined experience in healthcare project management and account/client success, preferably with exposure to behavioral health, care coordination, or population health in technology enabled services.
* Proven success independently leading complex implementations or partnerships involving provider organizations, payors, or health IT vendors, with minimal oversight.
* Experience with EHR integrations, referral management workflows, or value-based care initiatives strongly preferred.
* A consultative, proactive, solutions-oriented mindset with strong attention to detail.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, solve complex problems, and independently drive projects forward in dynamic environments.
* Strongly empathetic with a keen desire to reduce barriers to behavioral health and social services for the underserved.
* Ability to convey technical information and tailor communication across a range of audiences and levels, from junior project managers to clinicians, administrators, and C-level executives, exercising strong, independent judgment in what and how to communicate with customers.
* PMP (Project Management Professional, PMI) is preferred.

jobs.title: Partner Program Manager
jobs.description:
**See yourself at Twilio**

Join the team as Twilio’s next Partner Program Manager.

**About the job**

As we expand our partner ecosystem to support global growth targets, we are expanding our team to scale responsibly. We are seeking a versatile **Partner Program Manager** to drive an exceptional experience across our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. This balanced role bridges the gap between high-touch partner experience, strategic cross-functional project management, and advanced lifecycle automation. If you have a deep background in partnerships, an AI-forward mindset for process optimization, and hands-on experience with modern ecosystem toolsets, this role offers an exciting opportunity to shape the future of our global network.

In this role, you won't just follow a static blueprint—you will help build it. We are seeking a highly proactive partner program manager to drive exceptional experiences for our Systems Integrators (SIs), ISVs, Resell, and Technology partners. You will take the lead on optimizing the end-to-end partner journey, managing cross-functional projects, and eliminating operational friction.

This position requires a "can-do" attitude and a passion for continuous improvement. You will be responsible for transforming manual workflows into automated, scalable systems, managing key vendor capabilities, and implementing strategic initiatives that directly unlock ecosystem revenue velocity.

**Responsibilities**

In this role, you’ll:

* **Drive Program Modernization & Scale:** Act as an operational engine for the team, identifying process bottlenecks and proactively designing new ways to automate existing manual workflows.
* **Own Problem-Solving:** Step into complex challenges across the partner lifecycle and chart a clear path forward to build repeatable, programmatic solutions.
* **Optimize the Partner Experience:** Lead and refine core partner onboarding pathways, lifecycle touchpoints, and support workflows to deliver a seamless, world-class journey for external ecosystems.
* **Accelerate Partner Revenue Mechanics:** Build and execute operational frameworks that eliminate transaction friction, streamline incentive administration, and maximize partner-sourced revenue pipelines.
* **Manage Technology & Vendor Capabilities:** Serve as a strategic owner for key components of our partner tech stack and vendor relationships, ensuring our data models and tools are optimized for ecosystem scale rather than mere maintenance.
* **Orchestrate High-Touch Communications:** Develop and execute comprehensive partner engagement strategies, ensuring clear, accessible program documentation, impactful updates, and consistent enablement communications across all segments.
* **Lead Cross-Functional Project Execution:** Develop and run end-to-end project plans for new partner initiatives, collaborating closely with Product, Marketing, Sales, Legal, and Tech teams to ensure alignment and timely milestone delivery.

**Qualifications**

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

* **Required:**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field; relevant experience may be considered.
* **Experience:** 5–8 years of experience in partner program or project management, partner management, strategy and operations, or a similar role within a fast-paced technology company.
* **The "Get-Stuff-Done" Mindset:** A proven track record of operating effectively in complex environments, turning ambiguous problems into plans, and delivering results without a rigid instructions script.
* **Project Management & Collaboration:** Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage complex cross-functional timelines, align diverse stakeholders, and drive accountability.
* **Communication & Content:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills for translating complex program guidelines into clear, compelling partner assets, guides, and updates.

**Desired:**

* **Ecosystem Acumen:** Solid understanding of modern partner program structures, lifecycle methodologies, and experience working with SIs, ISVs, Resell, or Technology tracks.
* **Tech Stack & Automation Familiarity:** Hands-on exposure to CRM and partner ecosystem technologies (such as PRMs, account-mapping utilities, or data integration tools) with a strong desire to leverage software and AI to remove manual tasks.
* **Revenue Orientation:** Experience designing or supporting commercial program models, referral paths, or joint sales plays that directly drive channel pipelines.
* **Advanced Degree:** BA/BS degree or equivalent required. MBA is a plus.

**Location**

This role will be remote,but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

**Travel**

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

**What We Offer**

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

**Compensation**

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

* Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
* Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
* Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
* This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan.

jobs.title: Sales & Business Operations Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Sales & Business Operations Administrative Coordinator**

**Work Location:** Remote  
**Position Type:**Temporary – 4-month assignment with the possibility of extension based on business needs and operational requirements.  
**Work Schedule:** Candidates must be available to work Pacific Time business hours, Monday through Friday, from 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM PT.

**Position Summary**

Talent Table is seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Sales & Business Operations Administrative Coordinator to support daily sales operations, administrative workflows, and internal coordination.

The ideal candidate will have experience supporting private-sector sales or business operations teams and demonstrate strong organizational skills, independent follow-through, and the ability to turn management direction, meeting notes, and communications into actionable tasks.

This position is responsible for maintaining organized tracking systems, coordinating deadlines and deliverables, managing business documentation, and ensuring assigned activities continue moving forward without constant supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales Operations & Action Item Coordination**

* Review sales meeting notes, transcripts, emails, and management instructions to identify action items, assigned responsibilities, and next steps.
* Organize tasks by priority, establish follow-up timelines, and coordinate with responsible team members to ensure progress.
* Maintain visibility of outstanding activities, pending decisions, and completed deliverables.
* Proactively identify administrative gaps, request missing information, and escalate issues requiring management attention.

**2. Sales Tracking & Calendar Management**

* Maintain accurate tracking spreadsheets for sales opportunities, purchase orders (POs), quotes, agreements, contract renewals, and other business activities.
* Coordinate calendars, schedule meetings, and track important dates, including upcoming renewals, contract expirations, and administrative deadlines.
* Monitor the status of quotes, purchase orders, and pending documentation, ensuring appropriate follow-up with assigned personnel.
* Prepare concise status reports highlighting upcoming deadlines, priorities, and outstanding actions.

**3. Document & Agreement Management**

* Organize and maintain electronic folders, agreements, contracts, and supporting sales documentation.
* Establish consistent file-naming conventions, document organization, and version control.
* Maintain accurate records of document locations, agreement statuses, and related correspondence.
* Coordinate document requests, approvals, signatures, and distribution to appropriate internal departments.

**4. Internal Coordination & Operational Handoffs**

* Support the transition of administrative responsibilities by organizing handoff documents, training materials, and existing process instructions.
* Document administrative workflows and maintain reference materials to support operational continuity.
* Coordinate with sales, account management, accounting, and other internal teams to facilitate timely completion of assigned activities.
* Track internal handoffs and confirm that required information has been received by the appropriate team members.

**5. Sales Materials & General Administrative Support**

* Assist with formatting quotes, standard forms, spreadsheets, and client-facing documents using established templates and approved information.
* Provide administrative tracking and coordination for assigned RFPs and proposals, including deadlines, documentation, and submission records.
* Support additional sales and business operations activities as priorities and processes evolve.

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous experience in sales administration, business operations, executive assistance, or a similar administrative coordination role.
* Experience supporting private-sector business operations or B2B sales teams strongly preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and shared document management systems.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, anticipate next steps, and consistently follow through on assignments.

jobs.title: PSR Quality Leader
jobs.description:
The Power Sensing and Regulation Product Line Quality Leader develops and deploys the global quality strategy for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line. The role covers quality planning, quality assurance, quality control and the Quality Management System across the full product lifecycle, from tendering and product development to sourcing, manufacturing, project execution and service.
  
The role is reporting to the Product Line Leader, and functionally to the Business Line Quality Leader. The Product Line Quality Leader functionally leads factory quality leaders and collaborates with engineering, operations, sourcing, project and business leaders. The role is accountable for a strong quality culture, high customer satisfaction, prevention of customer escapes and continuous improvement of product and process quality.

**Job Description**
===================

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and deploy the global quality strategy, priorities and governance for the Power Sensing and Regulation product line, in full alignment with Power Transmission’s Quality roadmap.

* Drive the Zero-Defect Framework towards Level 4 through clear action plans, standard work, capability building and regular progress reviews.

* Ensure holistic integration of the factories' Quality Management Systems into Power Transmission's Business Management System. Take an active role in shaping the QMS to support the evolution of the business, in partnership with Power Transmission's central functions.

* Functionally lead and coach the factory quality teams. Set common standards, operating rhythms, measures and expectations across sites, and be accountable for meeting the Product Line Quality KPI targets.

* Be accountable for fulfilling quality engineering requirements during New Product Introduction (NPI) in the Product Line. Cover the full process from Design FMEA and Process FMEA through Control Plans and Reaction Plans, and drive aligned quality-built-in roadmaps across the Product Line.

* Lead complex global customer complaints and root cause analyses. Ensure rapid containment, clear customer communication, verified root cause and sustainable corrective action.

* Apply lessons learned and read across with factories and functions. Ensure relevant learning is built into risk analyses, standards and process controls.

* Drive a strong problem-solving culture using structured methods such as 8D, 5 Why, Ishikawa and fault-tree analysis.

* Use digital tools, data analytics and AI to improve prevention, traceability, risk detection and decision-making.

* Manage and drive the Customer Experience (CX) roadmap for the Product Line. Translate customer feedback and quality performance into clear priorities and improvement actions.

* Monitor and improve customer escapes, cost of poor quality, complaint closure, audit findings and first-pass yield.

* Build strong cross-functional teams with technical experts and business leaders to solve quality issues and deliver improvement plans.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* University degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a comparable technical field.

* At least 10 years of experience in quality, engineering or manufacturing, including leadership of global or multi-site activities.

* Strong technical knowledge of power sensing and regulation products, including design, manufacturing, testing, installation and service risks. Experience with instrument transformers, sensors, voltage regulation equipment, monitoring systems or related control technologies is preferred.

* Strong knowledge of Design FMEA, Process FMEA, APQP, Control Plans, Reaction Plans, MSA, SPC, process capability and ISO 9001.

* Experience with IEC or IEEE standards is a strong advantage.

* Proven experience leading major customer complaints, structured root cause analysis and corrective action programmes.

* Experience with digital quality systems, data analytics, automation or AI applications is an advantage.

* Fluent English.

**Desired Skills and Characteristics**

* Strong functional leadership and the ability to influence across a global matrix organisation.

* Customer-focused, fact-based and decisive during complex quality issues.

* Able to build trust and align technical experts, factory teams and business leaders around common goals.

* Clear communicator with the confidence to engage customers and senior leaders.

* Proactive, disciplined and focused on prevention, learning and sustainable results.

* Comfortable working with multicultural and cross-functional teams.

* Curious about digitalisation and AI, with a practical focus on business and quality outcomes.

* Collaborates openly with peers and functions, shares knowledge and works towards the best outcome for the Product Line and Power Transmission.

* Provides practical support, coaching and clear direction to factories and teams so they can meet their commitments and be successful.

* Demonstrates the GE Vernova Values in decisions, collaboration, customer engagement and daily leadership.

jobs.title: Care Team Lead, Care Experience
jobs.description:
**About Empathy**

Empathy is on a mission to help families through life’s most challenging moments. Our award-winning product, powered by tech and driven by purpose, provides peace of mind by guiding families through all the tedious and time-consuming tasks associated with loss. With a combination of tech and human support, we enable families to focus on what truly matters and support them through the emotions that follow.

Our team is passionate, empathetic, and dedicated to providing world-class solutions to families in need. We work collaboratively to identify pain points and design elegant solutions that empower and support our users.

**About the Role:**

As a Care Team Lead, your deep understanding of Empathy’s products, services, and processes is essential to confidently guide both users and the Care Team. You are accountable for the **quality, consistency, and impact** of care delivered by your team, ensuring that Care Managers and Care Specialists show up with empathy, clarity, and excellence - and that our users feel supported, understood, and confident at every touchpoint.

This role is centered on **people leadership, performance, and outcomes.** You will set clear expectations, assess quality through regular review, and provide hands-on coaching that supports growth while maintaining a high bar for care delivery. You play a critical role in shaping team culture by modeling Empathy’s values and translating strategy into day-to-day behaviors that improve both user experience and team effectiveness.

While cross-functional collaboration and process improvement are an important function of this role, the core of the role is leading a high performance team: developing talent, strengthening culture, and ensuring our care consistently meets the needs of the families we serve.

This role will continue to evolve as Empathy grows and is well suited for someone who is energized by ownership, accountability, and building strong, engaged teams.

  
Requirements:  
  

**About You:**

* 2+ years of experience leading teams in a customer-facing or care-focused environment (counseling/support/concierge services, or related fields)
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Strong organizational, documentation, and time management skills
* Comfortable using data and qualitative insights to assess performance and guide decision-making
* Able to work autonomously and effectively in a fast-paced, complex, and matrixed remote environment
* Comfortable with ambiguity and able to manage multiple priorities
* Deep care for team culture and user experience, with a proactive and growth-oriented mindset
* Adaptable and ready to take on evolving responsibilities as the team scales and needs shift.

**More Information:**

* *The salary for this position ranges between $68,000-$75,000 annually.*

Empathy is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace for all employees.

  
In this role you will:  
  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Leadership**

* Lead and manage a team of Care Managers and/or Care Specialists, ensuring they provide exceptional support to our users.
* Set clear performance expectations, provide regular coaching and feedback, and offer professional development opportunities.
* Own team-level outcomes related to care quality, user experience, and consistency across calls and chats.
* Foster an inclusive, collaborative team culture rooted in empathy, equity, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Provide real-time support to team members navigating challenging calls, scheduling conflicts, or urgent needs.

**Quality and Outcomes**

* Monitor call and chat quality through regular QA reviews and performance analysis, delivering timely and actionable feedback.
* Identify patterns and trends in quality or performance and proactively address gaps through coaching and partnership with Training and Development.
* Serve as an escalation point to model best practices for care in complex or high-impact user situations.

**Operations**

* Own the effective execution of existing workflows and team processes, ensuring clarity, consistency, and quality.
* Use data and performance insights to identify opportunities to improve team effectiveness, utilization, and user outcomes.
* Partner with Care Operations and Training and Development to surface frontline insights that inform process improvements and enablement efforts.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams as the Care Team representative bringing frontline context and advocating for care quality and team needs.
* Contribute insights that help ensure product, operational, and process decisions support strong user and team outcomes.

**Training and Development**

* Partner withTraining & Development to identify learning needs informed by quality and performance signals.
* Reinforce training through coaching and feedback that translates learnings into practice.
* Support onboarding by helping new team members understand care standards, expectations, and team norms.
* Assist with the hiring process by participating in interviews, evaluations, or onboarding planning as needed to help build and sustain a high performing team.

**Care Team SME**

* Maintain a deep understanding of the company's products, services, and processes.
* Handle a limited number of User cases as needed (predominantly VIPs, high-value LI users, etc).
* Oversee the resolution of complex user inquiries or issues, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolutions.

**About UnitX**
---------------

UnitX is building the AI-powered eyes and brain for autonomous manufacturing. Our machine-vision platform helps manufacturers detect complex defects, automate inspection, and improve production quality in applications where conventional vision systems fall short.

We are expanding into emerging, high-growth markets—including AI data-center infrastructure and next-generation AI hardware—and are looking for a business development leader to help establish UnitX as a strategic partner to the companies defining these industries.

==================

You'll make sure every part we buy arrives on time, every system we ship is right the first time, and every dollar and asset is accounted for. You'll work closely with Engineering, Field Deployment, Finance and Sales, and you'll be comfortable both negotiating with vendors and testing hardware at the bench.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Run domestic and international receiving and shipping for customer orders and internal hardware/software, including carriers, freight forwarders, customs documents and export compliance
* Bench-test incoming and outgoing hardware (power-on, imaging, camera/lens checks); triage failures with Engineering before shipment
* Own procurement for hardware (GPUs, industrial PCs, cameras, lenses, cables, lighting) and software licenses, from quotes and POs through approvals, renewals and cost tracking
* Manage vendor performance: track lead times and on-time delivery, resolve late or defective shipments and keep an approved vendor list
* Build and run inventory and asset management: system of record, cycle counts, reconciliation, asset tagging and RMAs
* Manage import and export compliance: classify products (HTS, ECCN), calculate duties, tariffs and landed cost, work with customs brokers, file export documents and keep records audit-ready
* Own the monthly operations dashboard (on-time delivery, shipment errors, spend vs budget, inventory accuracy); write and maintain SOPs; work with Sales and Field teams on demand and delivery planning; lead process improvement across NA operations
* Run the office, warehouse and lab space: layout, security, safety and EHS compliance, office supplies, facility vendors; Set up laptops and accounts, manage license seats, handle first-line hardware and network issues as needed

**What you'll bring**
=====================

* 5+ years in supply chain, operations or procurement at a hardware company
* Comfort assembling, powering on and troubleshooting computers, GPUs, cameras and cabling
* Hands-on experience shipping high-value products domestically and internationally (Incoterms, HTS codes, commercial invoices, export controls)
* Working knowledge of import and export duties and customs: tariff classification, duty and tariff impacts, customs broker management
* A record of buying both hardware and software licenses, including negotiating price and lead time
* Experience owning inventory and asset tracking in an ERP or inventory system (NetSuite, Odoo or similar) with high count accuracy
* Strong organization and follow-through; you like clean data and clear processes
* Able to work on-site in our Milpitas office, 5 days a week

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience at a machine vision, industrial automation, robotics or AI hardware company
* Experience building operations processes from scratch at a startup
* Experience working with global suppliers and contract manufacturers
* Bilingual in Mandarin is a plus

**Why Join UnitX**
==================

This role offers the opportunity to accelerate human productivity through robotics in manufacturing. You get to define how a differentiated AI-vision platform enters some of the world’s fastest-growing and most strategically important manufacturing markets. You will work directly with company leadership, influence product and market strategy, and build relationships that can become significant global accounts.

If you require assistance, please contact Human Resources. Requests for accommodation will be treated confidentially and in accordance with applicable laws.*

**Position Summary**

Girls on the Run of Greater Sacramento is seeking a highly organized, relationship-focused professional who is passionate about youth development and creating positive experiences for girls, volunteers, and community partners.

The Program Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring Girls on the Run programs are delivered with excellence across the Greater Sacramento region. This position combines program operations, volunteer engagement, and relationship management to support every stage of our seasonal programs. From helping families navigate registration, to supporting volunteer coaches, to partnering with schools and community sites, this team member helps create the systems and relationships that allow our mission to thrive.

Working closely with the Program Lead and Executive Director, the Program Operations Coordinator serves as a key connector between participants, families, coaches, schools, and community partners. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoys building strong relationships while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic nonprofit environment.

This position reports directly to the Executive Director.

**About the Role**

At Girls on the Run, successful programs are built through a combination of strong relationships and strong systems. This role helps ensure both are in place.

**Support Exceptional Program Delivery**

You will help create a seamless experience for participants and families from registration through the end of each season. This includes maintaining accurate participant information, supporting registration and scholarship processes, communicating with families, and ensuring program logistics are coordinated effectively.

Success in this area means families feel informed and supported, participant information is accurate, and program operations run smoothly throughout the season.

**Foster Meaningful Coach Relationships**

Volunteer coaches are the heart of Girls on the Run. In this role, you will help cultivate a positive experience for coaches by serving as a consistent point of contact, providing timely communication, answering questions, and connecting coaches with the resources they need to be successful.

**Manage Program Systems and Data**

As a primary user of the Girls on the Run program management platform, you will help ensure organizational data is accurate, current, and useful for decision-making.

This includes maintaining participant, coach, and site records; managing registration and roster information; generating reports; and supporting data-driven planning efforts. The ideal candidate enjoys creating order, solving problems, and using technology to support organizational success.

* Experience coordinating volunteers or volunteer-led programs.
* Experience with database, CRM, or registration management systems.
* Knowledge of community outreach, partnership development, or stakeholder engagement.
* Previous experience with Girls on the Run as a participant, coach, volunteer, or supporter.
